--pls :< @me
local DS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remote.Dungeon_Server
DS.TryClaimDailyDunTicRE:FireServer()
task.wait(0.2)
local entered = DS.TryIntoDungeonRF:InvokeServer(true, 50)
print("entered:", tostring(entered))
task.wait(0.2)
local done = false
local rounds = 0
for _ = 1, 5 do
    task.spawn(function()
        while not done do
            DS.StartRoundRE:FireServer(50)
            local result = DS.CompleteRoundRF:InvokeServer(50)
            if type(result) ~= "table" then
                done = true
                break
            end
            rounds += 1
        end
    end)
end
repeat task.wait(1) until done

N.ARROWS = { "12", "1:30", "3", "4:30", "6", "7:30", "9", "10:30" }
local function arrowFor(cam, pos)
	local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
	local a = math.atan2(rel.X, -rel.Z)
	local idx = math.floor((a + math.pi / 8) / (math.pi / 4)) % 8 + 1
	return N.ARROWS[idx]
end

local function getCamera() return workspace.CurrentCamera end
local function getRoot(char) return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local function getHum(char) return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end

local function isAlive(char)
	local hum = getHum(char)
	return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end

local function isTeammate(plr)
	return plr ~= nil and player.Team ~= nil and plr.Team == player.Team
end

local function getAimPart(char)
	local idx = S.AimPart
	local part
	if idx == 1 then
		part = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	elseif idx == 2 then
		part = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	end
	return part or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function scanNPCs()
	local list = {}
	for _, inst in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
			local char = inst.Parent
			if char and char ~= player.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) then
				list[#list + 1] = char
			end
		end
	end
	npcList = list
end

local function collect(ignoreTeam)
	local out = {}
	for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if plr ~= player and plr.Character and not (ignoreTeam and isTeammate(plr)) then
			out[#out + 1] = { char = plr.Character, plr = plr }
		end
	end
	if S.IncludeNPCs then
		for _, char in npcList do
			if char.Parent then out[#out + 1] = { char = char } end
		end
	end
	return out
end

	table.insert(widgets[key], fn)
	fn()

local function acc(obj, prop)
	table.insert(N.accentRefs, { obj, prop })
	obj[prop] = ACCENT
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	radius = radius or 2
	if radius < 1000 then radius = math.min(radius, 14) end
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function addStroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function makeText(parent, size, pos, text, textSize, color, font, align, noBind)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Size = size
	l.Position = pos
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color or N.C_TEXT
	l.Font = font or N.FONT
	l.TextSize = textSize or N.TXT
	l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	l.Parent = parent
	if text ~= "" and not noBind then bind(l, text) end
	return l
end

local function setValue(key, value, silent)
	S[key] = value
	for _, r in widgets[key] or {} do r() end
	if key == "Accent" then applyAccent() end
	if key == "Lang" then applyLang() end
	if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
	if key == "Coins" and startCoinLoop then startCoinLoop() end
	if not silent and type(value) == "boolean" and N.toggleLabels[key] and notify then
		notify(N.toggleLabels[key], value)
	end
end

local function toast(text, color, force, life)
	if not S.Toasts and not force then return end
	local dur = life or 1.8
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32)
	t.BackgroundColor3 = N.C_BG
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.BorderSizePixel = 0
	t.Text = "       " .. text .. "    "
	t.TextColor3 = N.C_TEXT
	t.TextTransparency = 1
	t.Font = FONT_B
	t.TextSize = 12
	t.Parent = UI.toasts
	corner(t, 9)
	local ts = addStroke(t, N.C_LINE, 1, 1)
	local mark = Instance.new("Frame")
	mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	mark.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
	mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, 0)
	mark.BackgroundColor3 = color or ACCENT
	mark.BorderSizePixel = 0
	mark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	mark.Parent = t
	corner(mark, 1000)
	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 1, -3)
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 2)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = color or ACCENT
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bar.Parent = t
	corner(bar, 1000)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	tween(t, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.04, TextTransparency = 0 }, info)
	tween(ts, { Transparency = 0.2 }, info)
	tween(mark, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, info)
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	tween(bar, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear))
	task.delay(dur, function()
		local out = TweenInfo.new(0.18)
		tween(t, { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 }, out)
		tween(ts, { Transparency = 1 }, out)
		tween(mark, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, out)
		tween(bar, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, out)
		task.delay(0.22, function() t:Destroy() end)
	end)
end

local function safeRun(name, fn)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		warn("[ZENITH] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		local msg = tostring(err)
		if #msg > 70 then msg = string.sub(msg, 1, 70) .. "…" end
		pcall(toast, "" .. name .. ": " .. msg, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), true, 12)
	end
end

local lastNote = {}
local function defNote(key, enabled, src, color, every, ...)
	if not enabled then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastNote[key] or 0) < (every or 2) then return end
	lastNote[key] = now
	local text = select("#", ...) > 0 and string.format(tr(src), ...) or tr(src)
	toast(text, color or ACCENT, true)
end

local menuOpenState = false
local menuTween, menuRest = nil, nil
local function openMenu(open)
	if open == nil then open = not menuOpenState end
	local win = UI.window
	if open == menuOpenState and win.Visible == open then
		if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
		return
	end
	menuOpenState = open
	if menuTween then menuTween:Cancel() menuTween = nil end

	if not menuRest or not win.Visible then menuRest = win.Position end
	local rest = menuRest
	local w = win.Size.X.Offset * UI.scale.Scale + 40
	local away = UDim2.new(rest.X.Scale, rest.X.Offset - w, rest.Y.Scale, rest.Y.Offset)

	if open then
		if not win.Visible then
			win.Position = away
			win.GroupTransparency = 1
			if not isTouch then UI.content.GroupTransparency = 1 end
		end
		win.Visible = true
		tween(win, { GroupTransparency = S.MenuAlpha }, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
		if not isTouch then tween(UI.content, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)) end
		menuTween = TweenService:Create(win, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = rest })
		menuTween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
				win.Position = rest
				menuRest = nil
			end
		end)
		menuTween:Play()
	else
		overMenu = false
		tween(win, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In))
		local tw = TweenService:Create(win, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = away })
		menuTween = tw
		tw.Completed:Connect(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not menuOpenState then
				win.Visible = false
				win.Position = rest
				menuRest = nil
				if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
			end
		end)
		tw:Play()
	end
	if applyVisuals then applyVisuals() end
end

local function availSize()
	local a = UI.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if a.X < 50 or a.Y < 50 then
		local cam = getCamera()
		return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
	end
	return a
end

local function effectiveScale()
	local avail = availSize()
	local auto = 1
	if S.AutoScale then
		if isTouch then
			auto = math.clamp(math.min(avail.X / 760, avail.Y / 330), 0.9, 1.15)
		else
			auto = math.clamp(math.min(avail.X / 820, avail.Y / 480), 0.7, 1.1)
		end
	end
	return S.UiScale * auto
end

N.leftOff = function()
	if not isTouch then return 12 end
	if availSize().X < 560 then return 8 end
	return N.DOCK_W + 18
end

local function placeWindow()
	local avail = availSize()
	local sc = UI.scale.Scale
	local vw = UI.window.Size.X.Offset * sc
	local vh = UI.window.Size.Y.Offset * sc

	local x, y
	if userMoved then
		x, y = UI.window.Position.X.Offset, UI.window.Position.Y.Offset
	else
		x = N.leftOff()
		y = N.WIN_TOP
	end
	x = math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(avail.X - vw, 0))
	y = math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(avail.Y - vh, 0))
	UI.window.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
end

local pages = {}
local currentPage


local function selectTab(page)
	local changed = currentPage ~= page
	currentPage = page
	for _, p in pages do
		local active = (p == page)
		if not active then p.frame.Visible = false end
		p.btn.BackgroundColor3 = N.C_ROW_HI
		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		tween(p.btn, { BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1, TextColor3 = active and N.C_TEXT or N.C_DIM }, info)
		tween(p.icon, { BackgroundColor3 = active and ACCENT or N.C_LINE, Size = active and UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8) or UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5) }, info)
		tween(p.pad, { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, active and N.TAB_PAD_ON or N.TAB_PAD) }, info)
	end
	page.frame.Visible = true
	if changed and UI.window.Visible then
		page.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0)
		if not isTouch then UI.content.GroupTransparency = 0.85 end
		tween(page.frame, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
		if not isTouch then tween(UI.content, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)) end
		UI.sweep.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		UI.sweep.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		tween(UI.sweep, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -(N.SIDE_W + 1), 0, 1) }, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
		task.delay(0.3, function() tween(UI.sweep, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, TweenInfo.new(0.25)) end)
		pcall(function()
			local strip, btn = UI.sidebar, page.btn
			local y = btn.AbsolutePosition.Y - strip.AbsolutePosition.Y + strip.CanvasPosition.Y
			local target = math.max(y - strip.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 + btn.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2, 0)
			tween(strip, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, target) }, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
		end)
	else
		page.frame.Position = UDim2.new()
	end
end

local function makeRow(page, height, clickable, filled)

	row.LayoutOrder = page.n

	row.BackgroundColor3 = filled and N.C_PANEL or N.C_ROW_HI
	row.BackgroundTransparency = filled and 0 or 1
	row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	if clickable then
		row.Text = ""
		row.AutoButtonColor = false
		local restColor = filled and N.C_PANEL or N.C_ROW_HI
		local restAlpha = filled and 0 or 1
		local touchOnly = isTouch and not N.hasMouse
		if not touchOnly then
			row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = N.C_ROW_HI, BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
			end)
			row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = restColor, BackgroundTransparency = restAlpha }, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
			end)
		end
		row.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = N.C_LINE, BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, TweenInfo.new(0.05))
		end)
		row.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			if touchOnly then
				tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = restColor, BackgroundTransparency = restAlpha }, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
			else
				tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = N.C_ROW_HI }, TweenInfo.new(0.12))
			end
		end)
	end
	row.Parent = page.frame
	corner(row, 9)
	if filled then addStroke(row, N.C_LINE, 1, 0.35) end
	return row
end

	register(key, function()

		local tGoal = { BackgroundColor3 = on and ACCENT or N.C_LINE }
		local kGoal = {
			Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),

			for p, v in tGoal do track[p] = v end
			for p, v in kGoal do knob[p] = v end
		else
			local info = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function getAimPoint()
	local cam = getCamera()
	if isTouch and not N.hasMouse then
		return cam.ViewportSize / 2
	end
	if not overMenu then
		lastAimPoint = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end
	return lastAimPoint
end

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function getTarget(useFov, motion)
	local cam = getCamera()
	if not cam then return nil end

	local point = getAimPoint()
	local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
	local myChar = player.Character
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { myChar } or {}

	local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
	for _, t in collect(S.IgnoreTeam) do
		local char = t.char
		local hum, part = getHum(char), getAimPart(char)
		if hum and part and hum.Health > 0 then
			local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			local d2 = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - point).Magnitude
			local dist = (part.Position - camPos).Magnitude

			local pass = true
			if useFov then pass = onScreen and d2 <= S.FovRadius end
			if pass and S.WallCheck then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(camPos, part.Position - camPos, rayParams)
				pass = hit == nil or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
			end

			if pass then
				local score
				if S.Priority == 1 then
					score = onScreen and d2 or (1e6 + dist)
				elseif S.Priority == 2 then
					score = dist
				else
					score = hum.Health
				end
				if score < bestScore then
					best, bestScore = t, score
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if motion then
		for _, m in motionTargets do
			local part = m.part
			if part and part.Parent then
				local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				local d2 = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - point).Magnitude
				local dist = (part.Position - camPos).Magnitude
				local pass = true
				if useFov then pass = onScreen and d2 <= S.FovRadius end
				if pass and S.WallCheck then
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(camPos, part.Position - camPos, rayParams)
					pass = hit == nil or hit.Instance == part or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(m.model)
				end
				if pass then
					local score
					if S.Priority == 1 then
						score = onScreen and d2 or (1e6 + dist)
					else
						score = dist
					end
					if score < bestScore then
						best, bestScore = { char = m.model, part = part, motion = true }, score
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function teleportNear(tChar, mode)
	local myChar = player.Character
	local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
	local tRoot = getRoot(tChar)
	if not (isAlive(myChar) and myRoot and tRoot) then return false end

	lastTp = os.clock()

	local offset
	if mode == 1 then
		offset = -tRoot.CFrame.LookVector * S.TpOffset
	elseif mode == 2 then
		offset = tRoot.CFrame.RightVector * S.TpOffset
	else
		offset = Vector3.new(0, S.TpOffset, 0)
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { myChar, tChar }
	local pos = tRoot.Position + offset
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(tRoot.Position, offset, params)
	if hit then pos = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 2 end

	local cf
	if mode == 1 then
		cf = CFrame.new(pos) * tRoot.CFrame.Rotation
	else
		local look = Vector3.new(tRoot.Position.X, pos.Y, tRoot.Position.Z)
		cf = (look - pos).Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(pos, look) or CFrame.new(pos)
	end

	markSelf()
	myChar:PivotTo(cf)
	myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	return true
end

local function teleportToTarget()
	local t = getTarget(S.TpUseFov)
	if not t then return false end
	return teleportNear(t.char, S.TpMode)
end

local function randomTeleport(char)
	local root = getRoot(char)
	if not root then return end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

	local minD = math.min(S.TpDmgMin, S.TpDmgMax)
	local maxD = math.max(S.TpDmgMin, S.TpDmgMax)

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local angle = math.rad(math.random(0, 359))
		local dist = math.random(minD, maxD)
		local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 50, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), params)
		if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 then
			markSelf()
			char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			return
		end
	end
end

local lastDmgTp = 0
local function hookCharacter(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not hum then return end
	local last = hum.Health
	hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(new)
		if S.TpDmg and new < last and new > 0 and os.clock() - lastDmgTp >= S.TpDmgCd then
			lastDmgTp = os.clock()
			randomTeleport(char)
		end
		last = new
	end)
end

		if S.Esp then
			for _, t in collect(false) do
				local char, plr = t.char, t.plr
				local hum, root = getHum(char), getRoot(char)
				if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
					local dist = (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude
					local hide = (S.EspHideTeam and isTeammate(plr))
						or (S.EspMaxDist < 5000 and dist > S.EspMaxDist)

					if not hide then
						seen[char] = true
						local e = espObjs[char]
						if not e then
							e = createEsp(char)
							espObjs[char] = e
						end

						local frac = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
						local fillColor = colorOf(S.EspFill)
						local outColor = colorOf(S.EspOutline)
						if S.EspTeamColor and plr and plr.Team then
							fillColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
							outColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
						end
						if S.EspHealthColor then
							fillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
						end

						e.hl.Enabled = S.EspHighlight
						e.hl.FillColor = fillColor
						e.hl.OutlineColor = outColor
						e.hl.FillTransparency = S.EspFillTrans
						e.hl.OutlineTransparency = S.EspOutTrans
						e.hl.DepthMode = S.EspAlwaysOnTop
							and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
							or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded

						e.bb.Enabled = S.EspNames or S.EspHealth or S.EspDist
						e.bb.Adornee = root

						e.name.Visible = S.EspNames
						e.name.TextSize = S.EspTextSize
						e.name.Text = plr and plr.DisplayName or char.Name

						local parts = {}
						if S.EspHealth then
							parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d HP", math.floor(hum.Health + 0.5))
						end
						if S.EspDist then
							parts[#parts + 1] = string.format(tr("%d ст"), math.floor(dist + 0.5))
						end
						e.info.Visible = #parts > 0
						e.info.TextSize = S.EspTextSize - 1
						e.info.Text = table.concat(parts, "  |  ")

						e.bar.Visible = S.EspHealth
						e.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, 1)
						e.fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for char in espObjs do
			if not seen[char] then destroyEsp(char) end
		end
	end
end

do
	local coinThread = false

	startCoinLoop = function()
		if coinThread or not S.Coins then return end
		coinThread = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local cache, lastScan = {}, 0
			while S.Coins do
				local char = player.Character
				local root = getRoot(char)
				local pattern = string.lower(S.CoinName)

				if root and isAlive(char) and pattern ~= "" then

					if os.clock() - lastScan > 3 then
						lastScan = os.clock()
						cache = {}
						for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do
							if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), pattern, 1, true) then
								local model = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
								if not (model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
									cache[#cache + 1] = d
								end
							end
						end
					end

					local best, bestDist = nil, S.CoinRange
					for _, coin in cache do
						if coin.Parent then
							local d = (coin.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
							if d <= bestDist then best, bestDist = coin, d end
						end
					end

					if best then
						local origin = root.CFrame
						markSelf(0.6)
						char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(best.Position))
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						if S.CoinReturn and char.Parent then
							markSelf(0.6)
							char:PivotTo(origin)
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(S.CoinInterval)
			end
			coinThread = false
		end)
	end
end

local function exportConfig()

local function importConfig()
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return N.HttpService:JSONDecode(S.CfgText) end)
	if not (ok and type(data) == "table") then
		toast(tr("Невірний формат налаштувань"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for k, v in data do
		if k ~= "CfgText" and DEFAULTS[k] ~= nil and type(v) == type(DEFAULTS[k]) then
			setValue(k, v, true)
			n += 1
		end
	end
	toast(string.format(tr("Імпортовано: %d"), n), ACCENT, true)
end

local cfgSlots = {}
N.CFG_SKIP = { CfgText = true, Lang = true, CfgSlot = true }

local function cfgSimple(v)
	local t = type(v)
	return t == "boolean" or t == "number" or t == "string"
end

local function snapshotConfig()
	local out, n = {}, 0
	for k, v in DEFAULTS do
		if not N.CFG_SKIP[k] and cfgSimple(v) and S[k] ~= v then
			out[k] = S[k]
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return out, n
end

local function refreshCfgInfo()
	if not cfgInfoLabel then return end
	local lines = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local slot = cfgSlots[i]
		local mark = i == S.CfgSlot and "> " or "  "
		if slot then
			lines[i] = string.format("%s%d  %s  (%d)", mark, i, slot.at, slot.count)
		else
			lines[i] = string.format("%s%d  %s", mark, i, tr("порожньо"))
		end
	end
	cfgInfoLabel.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function cfgSave()
	local data, n = snapshotConfig()
	cfgSlots[S.CfgSlot] = { data = data, count = n, at = os.date("%H:%M:%S") }
	refreshCfgInfo()
	toast(string.format(tr("Збережено у слот %d"), S.CfgSlot), ACCENT, true)
end

local function cfgApply(data)
	for k, v in DEFAULTS do
		if not N.CFG_SKIP[k] and cfgSimple(v) then
			local nv = data[k]
			if nv == nil then nv = v end
			if type(nv) == type(v) and S[k] ~= nv then setValue(k, nv, true) end
		end
	end
end

local function cfgLoad()
	local slot = cfgSlots[S.CfgSlot]
	if not slot then
		toast(tr("Слот порожній"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
		return
	end
	cfgApply(slot.data)
	toast(string.format(tr("Завантажено зі слота %d"), S.CfgSlot), ACCENT, true)
end

local function cfgClear()
	cfgSlots[S.CfgSlot] = nil
	refreshCfgInfo()
end

local function cfgToText()
	local slot = cfgSlots[S.CfgSlot]
	if not slot then
		toast(tr("Слот порожній"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
		return
	end
	local ok, txt = pcall(function() return N.HttpService:JSONEncode(slot.data) end)
	setValue("CfgText", ok and txt or "", true)
	toast(tr("Слот скопійовано в поле"), ACCENT, true)
end

local function cfgFromText()
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return N.HttpService:JSONDecode(S.CfgText) end)
	if not (ok and type(data) == "table") then
		toast(tr("Невірний формат налаштувань"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for _ in data do n += 1 end
	cfgSlots[S.CfgSlot] = { data = data, count = n, at = os.date("%H:%M:%S") }
	refreshCfgInfo()
	toast(string.format(tr("Збережено у слот %d"), S.CfgSlot), ACCENT, true)
end

local splashDone = false

local function fadeAll(container, t)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
	local function fade(o)
		if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		elseif o:IsA("Frame") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		elseif o:IsA("UIStroke") then
			TweenService:Create(o, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end
	fade(container)
	for _, d in container:GetDescendants() do fade(d) end
end

local function runSplash()
	if splashDone then return end
	splashDone = true
	if not N.SHOW_INTRO then return end
	splashActive = true

	local gui
	local function cleanup()
		splashActive = false
		local g = gui
		gui = nil
		if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
	end

	task.delay(16, cleanup)

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local rng = Random.new()
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local chosen = false
		local qOut = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local function later(t, fn)
			task.delay(t, function()
				if gui then fn() end
			end)
		end

		gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "FunModeIntro"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
		gui.Parent = playerGui

		local root = Instance.new("Frame")
		root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 7, 10)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		root.BorderSizePixel = 0
		root.Active = true
		root.Parent = gui
		TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.04 }):Play()

		local hair = Instance.new("Frame")
		hair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		hair.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, isTouch and 0.33 or 0.36)
		hair.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		hair.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
		hair.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
		hair.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hair.Parent = root
		TweenService:Create(hair, TweenInfo.new(1.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1) }):Play()
		later(1.3, function()
			TweenService:Create(hair, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		end)

		local cs = isTouch and 7 or 11
		local gridW = (#N.PROJECT_NAME * 5 + (#N.PROJECT_NAME - 1) * 2) * cs
		local gridH = 7 * cs
		local bannerH = gridH + (isTouch and 96 or 118)
		local bannerW = math.max(gridW + cs * 10, 300)

		local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
		banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		banner.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, isTouch and 0.33 or 0.36)
		banner.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bannerW, bannerH)
		banner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		banner.Parent = root

		local bScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		bScale.Scale = 0.94
		bScale.Parent = banner
		TweenService:Create(bScale, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()

		local bStroke = addStroke(banner, N.C_LINE, 1, 1)
		later(1.4, function()
			TweenService:Create(bStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.6), { Transparency = 0 }):Play()
		end)

		local slats = 9
		for i = 1, slats do
			local s = Instance.new("Frame")
			s.BorderSizePixel = 0
			s.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / slats, i < slats and 1 or 0)
			s.Position = UDim2.new(i % 2 == 0 and 1.8 or -1.8, 0, (i - 1) / slats, 0)
			local shade = 13 + (i % 3) * 2
			s.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(shade, shade + 1, shade + 6)
			s.Parent = banner
			later(0.15 + (i - 1) * 0.1, function()
				TweenService:Create(s, qOut, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (i - 1) / slats, 0) }):Play()
			end)
		end

		local function edge(y, delayT)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, y, 0)
			f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.Parent = banner
			later(delayT, function()
				TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2) }):Play()
			end)
			return f
		end
		edge(0, 1.5)
		edge(1, 1.6)

		local function bracket(ax, ay, d)
			local sx = ax == 0 and -1 or 1
			local sy = ay == 0 and -1 or 1
			local hz = Instance.new("Frame")
			hz.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
			hz.Position = UDim2.new(ax, sx * 30, ay, sy * 30)
			hz.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
			hz.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
			hz.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			hz.BorderSizePixel = 0
			hz.Parent = banner
			local vt = hz:Clone()
			vt.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 0)
			vt.Parent = banner
			later(d, function()
				local info = TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				local to = UDim2.new(ax, sx * 12, ay, sy * 12)
				TweenService:Create(hz, info, { Position = to, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 2), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
				TweenService:Create(vt, info, { Position = to, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
			end)
		end
		bracket(0, 0, 1.0)
		bracket(1, 0, 1.1)
		bracket(1, 1, 1.2)
		bracket(0, 1, 1.3)

		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -6)
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
		progress.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = banner

		local pct = makeText(banner, UDim2.fromOffset(60, 14), UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -14), "000", 10, N.C_DIM, N.FONT_MONO,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
		pct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)

		local grid = Instance.new("Frame")
		grid.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		grid.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, isTouch and 26 or 32)
		grid.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gridW, gridH)
		grid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		grid.Parent = banner

		local cells = {}
		local charset = N.PROJECT_NAME
		local n = 0
		for li = 1, #N.PROJECT_NAME do
			local g = N.GLYPHS[string.sub(N.PROJECT_NAME, li, li)]
			if g then
				local ox = (li - 1) * 7 * cs
				for r = 1, 7 do
					for c = 1, 5 do
						if string.sub(g[r], c, c) == "1" then
							n += 1
							local ch = string.sub(charset, (n - 1) % #charset + 1, (n - 1) % #charset + 1)
							local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cs, cs)
							local fx, fy = ox + (c - 1) * cs, (r - 1) * cs
							l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							l.Text = ch
							l.TextColor3 = ACCENT
							l.Font = N.FONT_MONO
							l.TextSize = cs + 1

local function flyUpdate(char, root, hum, dt)
		if S.Fly then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local move = hum.MoveDirection
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if cam and move.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				dir = move
				if S.FlyPitch then
					local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
					local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
					local fwd = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and move:Dot(flat.Unit) or 0
					dir += Vector3.new(0, look.Y * fwd, 0)
				end
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or (isTouch and hum.Jump) then
				dir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
				dir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, dir.Y * S.FlyVert / 100, dir.Z)
			local moving = dir.Magnitude > 0.05
			if moving and dir.Magnitude > 1 then dir = dir.Unit end

			if moving or S.FlyHold then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
			flyOn = true
			markSelf(0.6)

			local ramp = 1
			if S.FlyRamp then
				flyRampT = moving and math.min(flyRampT + dt, S.FlyRampTime) or 0
				ramp = 0.2 + 0.8 * flyRampT / math.max(S.FlyRampTime, 0.05)
			else
				flyRampT = 0
			end
			local step = S.FlyStep * ramp
			local tick = math.max(S.FlyTickMs / 1000, step / math.max(S.FlyMaxSps, 1))

			local function advance(dist)
				local delta = dir * dist
				if S.FlyWalls and not S.Noclip then
					flyRp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
					local r = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, dir.Unit * (dist + 2), flyRp)
					if r then delta = dir.Unit * math.max(r.Distance - 2, 0) end
				end
				if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					root.CFrame = root.CFrame + delta
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end

			local mode = S.FlyMode
			if moving and (mode == 2 or mode == 3) then
				local sps = math.min(step / tick, S.FlyMaxSps)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * (mode == 3 and sps * 0.5 or sps)
			end
			if moving and mode ~= 2 then
				if S.FlySmooth then
					flyAcc = 0
					advance(step * math.min(dt / tick, 1))
				else
					flyAcc += dt
					if flyAcc >= tick then
						flyAcc = 0
						advance(step)
					end
				end
			else
				flyAcc = tick
			end
		elseif flyOn then
			flyOn = false
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
			markSelf(1.5)
		end
end

local flyErrShown = false
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)

	if (S.IncludeNPCs or S.EspNPC) and os.clock() - lastNpcScan > 2 then
		lastNpcScan = os.clock()
		scanNPCs()
	end

	if root and hum then

		if S.SpeedOn then
			if orig.walk == nil then orig.walk = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = S.Speed
		elseif orig.walk ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = orig.walk
			orig.walk = nil
		end

		if S.JumpOn then
			if orig.jump == nil then
				orig.jump = hum.JumpPower
				orig.useJP = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower = S.JumpPower
		elseif orig.jump ~= nil then
			hum.UseJumpPower = orig.useJP
			hum.JumpPower = orig.jump
			orig.jump = nil
		end

		if S.TpAuto and os.clock() - lastTp >= S.TpInterval and os.clock() - lastTpTry >= 0.1 then
			lastTpTry = os.clock()
			teleportToTarget()
		end

		do
			local okF, errF = pcall(flyUpdate, char, root, hum, dt)
			if not okF and not flyErrShown then
				flyErrShown = true
				warn("[ZENITH] fly: " .. tostring(errF))
				pcall(toast, "Fly: " .. tostring(errF), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), true, 8)
			end
		end

		if S.Bhop and not S.Fly then
			local now = os.clock()
			local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local move = hum.MoveDirection
			local keyHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
			local touchHeld = isTouch and hum.Jump and now - bhopSet > 0.15
			local held = keyHeld or touchHeld
			local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
			local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil or hum.Sit
			if held and not seated and hum.Health > 0 then
				if grounded then
					local carry = bhopHV
					if move.Magnitude < 0.01 then carry = Vector3.zero end
					local jp = hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * workspace.Gravity * hum.JumpHeight)
					local hv = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
					if carry.Magnitude > hv.Magnitude then hv = carry end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hv.X, jp, hv.Z)
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					bhopSet = now
					markSelf(0.6)
				elseif move.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					local wish = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z).Unit
					local hv = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
					local addSpeed = 12 - hv:Dot(wish)
					if addSpeed > 0 then
						hv += wish * math.min(addSpeed, S.BhopGain * 120 * dt)
					end
					if hv.Magnitude > S.BhopMax then hv = hv.Unit * S.BhopMax end
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hv.X, v.Y, hv.Z)
					bhopHV = hv
					markSelf(0.6)
				else
					bhopHV = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
				end
			else
				bhopHV = Vector3.zero
			end
		end

		if S.Spin then
			hum.AutoRotate = false
			spinOn = true
			local pos = root.Position
			if S.SpinMode == 1 then
				spinAngle = (spinAngle + S.SpinSpeed * dt) % 360
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(spinAngle), 0)
			elseif S.SpinMode == 2 then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 359)), 0)
			else
				local cam = getCamera()
				local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.zAxis
				local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos - flat)
				end
			end
		elseif spinOn then
			hum.AutoRotate = true
			spinOn = false
		end
	end

	espTimer += dt
	if espTimer >= 0.1 then
		espTimer = 0
		updateEsp()
		if S.Debug then updateFooter() end
	end
end)

		[0x43A] = "k", [0x43B] = "l", [0x43C] = "m", [0x43D] = "n", [0x43E] = "o",
		[0x43F] = "p", [0x440] = "r", [0x441] = "s", [0x442] = "t", [0x443] = "u",
		[0x444] = "f", [0x445] = "kh", [0x446] = "ts", [0x447] = "ch", [0x448] = "sh",
		[0x449] = "shch", [0x44A] = "", [0x44B] = "y", [0x44C] = "", [0x44D] = "e",
		[0x44E] = "yu", [0x44F] = "ya",
	}
	local LEET = { ["0"] = "o", ["1"] = "i", ["3"] = "e", ["4"] = "a", ["5"] = "s", ["7"] = "t", ["@"] = "a", ["$"] = "s" }
	local foldCache = {}

	local function fold(s)
		local cached = foldCache[s]
		if cached then return cached end

		local out = {}
		local ok = pcall(function()
			for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do
				local c = cp
				if c >= 0x410 and c <= 0x42F then c += 32
				elseif c >= 0x400 and c <= 0x40F then c += 80
				elseif c == 0x490 then c = 0x491 end

				if c < 128 then
					local ch = string.lower(string.char(c))
					ch = LEET[ch] or ch
					if string.find(ch, "^%w+$") then out[#out + 1] = ch end
				elseif TRANSLIT[c] then
					out[#out + 1] = TRANSLIT[c]
				end
			end
		end)

		local result
		if ok then
			result = table.concat(out)
		else
			result = string.gsub(string.lower(s), "[^%w]", "")
		end
		foldCache[s] = result
		return result
	end

	local function parseList(text)
		local list = {}
		for token in string.gmatch(tostring(text), "[^,;\n]+") do
			local f = fold(token)
			if #f >= 3 then list[#list + 1] = f end
		end
		return list
	end

	local function matches(name, include, exclude)
		local f = fold(name)
		for _, ex in exclude do
			if string.find(f, ex, 1, true) then return false end
		end
		for _, inc in include do
			if string.find(f, inc, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local droneCache, enemyList = {}, {}
	local scanning, lastScan, forceScan = false, 0, true
	local lastEnemy = 0
	local lastNameKey = ""

	local function inAnyCharacter(inst)
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local c = plr.Character
			if c and inst:IsDescendantOf(c) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function rescan()
		if scanning then return end
		scanning = true
		lastScan = os.clock()
		forceScan = false

		task.spawn(function()
			local include, exclude = parseList(S.DrName), parseList(S.DrExclude)
			local found, set, sizeCache = {}, {}, {}

			local function sizeOf(inst)
				local s = sizeCache[inst]
				if s then return s end
				if inst:IsA("Model") then
					s = inst:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude
				else
					s = inst.Size.Magnitude
				end
				sizeCache[inst] = s
				return s
			end

			local function consider(inst, checkSize)
				if not inst or not inst.Parent or set[inst] then return end
				if inAnyCharacter(inst) then return end

				local target = inst
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
					target = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or inst
				end
				if checkSize and sizeOf(target) > MAX_DRONE_SIZE then

					if inst:IsA("BasePart") and target ~= inst and sizeOf(inst) <= MAX_DRONE_SIZE then
						target = inst
					else
						return
					end
				end
				if not set[target] then
					set[target] = true
					found[#found + 1] = target
				end
			end

			for _, inst in N.CollectionService:GetTagged(DRONE_TAG) do
				consider(inst, false)
			end

			if #include > 0 then
				local n = 0
				for _, inst in workspace:GetDescendants() do
					n += 1
					if n % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end
					if inst.Parent and (inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("BasePart")) then
						if matches(inst.Name, include, exclude) then
							consider(inst, true)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local out = {}
			for _, m in found do
				local nested = false
				local p = m.Parent
				while p and p ~= workspace do
					if set[p] then nested = true break end
					p = p.Parent
				end
				if not nested then out[#out + 1] = m end
			end

			droneCache = out
			scanning = false
		end)
	end

	local function dronePos(m)
		if m:IsA("Model") then return m:GetPivot().Position end
		return m.Position
	end

	local function dronePart(m)
		if m:IsA("BasePart") then return m end
		return m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	local function rebuildEnemies()
		local out = {}
		for _, m in droneCache do
			if m.Parent then
				local own, team = false, false
				local uid = m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
				if uid == player.UserId then own = true end

				local ownerPlr = uid and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
				if not ownerPlr then
					for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
						if string.find(m.Name, plr.Name, 1, true) then
							ownerPlr = plr
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if ownerPlr == player then own = true end
				if ownerPlr and isTeammate(ownerPlr) then team = true end

				if not own and not team then out[#out + 1] = m end
			end
		end
		enemyList = out
	end

	droneReport = function()
		forceScan = true
		rescan()
		task.spawn(function()
			while scanning do task.wait(0.05) end
			rebuildEnemies()
			toast(string.format(tr("Дронів знайдено: %d (ворожих: %d)"), #droneCache, #enemyList), ACCENT, true)
		end)
	end

	local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	espFolder.Name = "FunModeDroneESP"
	espFolder.Parent = playerGui
	local dEsp = {}

	local function clearEsp()
		for m, e in dEsp do
			e.hl:Destroy()
			e.bb:Destroy()
			dEsp[m] = nil
		end
	end

	local function updateDroneEsp(rootPos)
		if not S.DrEsp then clearEsp() return end
		local seen = {}
		for _, m in enemyList do
			seen[m] = true
			local e = dEsp[m]
			if not e then
				local part = dronePart(m)
				if part then
					local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
					hl.Adornee = m
					hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
					hl.Parent = espFolder

					local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
					bb.Adornee = part
					bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
					bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 18)
					bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
					bb.Parent = espFolder

					local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
					t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
					t.TextSize = 13
					t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
					t.Parent = bb

					e = { hl = hl, bb = bb, text = t }
					dEsp[m] = e
				end
			end
			if e then
				local c = colorOf(S.DrEspColor)
				e.hl.FillColor, e.hl.OutlineColor = c, c
				e.text.TextColor3 = c
				e.text.Text = string.format(tr("ДРОН %d ст"), math.floor((dronePos(m) - rootPos).Magnitude))
			end
		end
		for m, e in dEsp do
			if not seen[m] then
				e.hl:Destroy()
				e.bb:Destroy()
				dEsp[m] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local warnLabel = makeText(UI.gui, UDim2.fromOffset(320, 28), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.16, 0),
		"", 18, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), FONT_B, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
	warnLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	warnLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	warnLabel.Visible = false

	local vig = Instance.new("Frame")
	vig.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	vig.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vig.Active = false
	vig.Parent = UI.overlay
	local vigStroke = addStroke(vig, Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40), 14, 1)

	local espTimer2, lastEvade, lastFire = 0, 0, 0

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeDrones", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
		local anyOn = S.DrEsp or S.DrWarn or S.DrAim or S.DrAutoFire or S.DrEvade
		local cam = getCamera()
		local char = player.Character
		local root = getRoot(char)

		if not (anyOn and gateOpen and cam and root) then
			warnLabel.Visible = false
			vigStroke.Transparency = 1
			clearEsp()
			return
		end

		local nameKey = S.DrName .. "|" .. S.DrExclude
		if nameKey ~= lastNameKey then
			lastNameKey = nameKey
			forceScan = true
		end
		if (forceScan or os.clock() - lastScan > 4) and not scanning then
			rescan()
		end
		if os.clock() - lastEnemy > 0.25 then
			lastEnemy = os.clock()
			rebuildEnemies()
		end

		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position

		local nearest, nearestDist
		for _, m in enemyList do
			if m.Parent then
				local d = (dronePos(m) - root.Position).Magnitude
				if not nearestDist or d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = m, d end
			end
		end

		espTimer2 += dt
		if espTimer2 >= 0.1 then
			espTimer2 = 0
			updateDroneEsp(root.Position)
		end

		if S.DrWarn and nearest and nearestDist <= S.DrWarnRadius then
			warnLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ДРОН %s %d ст"), arrowFor(cam, dronePos(nearest)), math.floor(nearestDist))
			warnLabel.Visible = true
			vigStroke.Transparency = 0.55 + 0.35 * math.sin(os.clock() * 10)
		else
			warnLabel.Visible = false
			vigStroke.Transparency = 1
		end

		local aimActive = S.DrAim and (not S.AimHold or not N.hasMouse or aimHeld)
		if aimActive or S.DrAutoFire then
			local point = getAimPoint()
			local bestPos, bestScore
			for _, m in enemyList do
				if m.Parent then
					local pos = dronePos(m)
					if (pos - camPos).Magnitude <= S.DrAimRange then
						local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
						if onScreen then
							local d2 = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - point).Magnitude
							if not bestScore or d2 < bestScore then
								bestPos, bestScore = pos, d2
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if bestPos then
				if aimActive then
					cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camPos, bestPos), math.max(S.Smooth, 0.35))
				end
				if S.DrAutoFire and os.clock() - lastFire > 0.12 then
					local dir = (bestPos - camPos).Unit
					if dir:Dot(cam.CFrame.LookVector) > 0.9962 then
						local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
						if tool then
							lastFire = os.clock()
							tool:Activate()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if S.DrEvade and nearest and nearestDist <= S.DrEvadeRadius
			and os.clock() - lastEvade >= S.DrEvadeCd and isAlive(char) then
			lastEvade = os.clock()
			local dpos = dronePos(nearest)
			local away = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - dpos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - dpos.Z)
			away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-60, 60)), 0) * away
				local origin = root.Position + dir * S.DrEvadeDist + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), params)
				if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.7 then
					markSelf()
					char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("anti-fling", function()
	local afSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local afParts = {}
	local afRefresh = 0
	local flagged = {}
	local lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
	local lastHum, lastBlock = nil, nil
	local scanT = 0
	local lastNC = nil

	local function refreshParts()
		afRefresh = os.clock()
		local fresh = {}
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			local char = plr.Character
			if plr ~= player and char then
				local parts = {}
				for _, d in char:GetDescendants() do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts[#parts + 1] = d end
				end
				local old = afParts[char]
				fresh[char] = { plr = plr, parts = parts, on = old and old.on or false }
			end
		end
		afParts = fresh
	end

	local function restoreCollisions()
		for part in afSaved do
			if part.Parent then part.CanCollide = true end
			afSaved[part] = nil
		end
	end

	RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		local on = S.AntiFling and gateOpen
		local nc = on and S.AfNoCollide

		if lastNC ~= nc then
			lastNC = nc
			restoreCollisions()
			for _, e in afParts do e.on = false end
		end
		if not on then return end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - afRefresh > 1 then refreshParts() end

		local myRoot = getRoot(player.Character)
		local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position

		for char, e in afParts do
			local r = getRoot(char)
			local near = myPos ~= nil and r ~= nil and (r.Position - myPos).Magnitude < 80

			local apply = char.Parent ~= nil and near and (nc or (flagged[e.plr] or 0) > now)
			if apply or e.on then
				for _, part in e.parts do
					if part.Parent then
						if apply then
							if part.CanCollide then
								afSaved[part] = true
								part.CanCollide = false
							end
						elseif afSaved[part] then
							part.CanCollide = true
							afSaved[part] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				e.on = apply and true or false
			end
		end
	end)

	local function applyStates(hum, block)
		pcall(function()
			hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, not block)
			hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, not block)
		end)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local on = S.AntiFling and gateOpen

		if not on then
			if lastHum and lastBlock then applyStates(lastHum, false) end
			lastHum, lastBlock = nil, nil
			lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
			return
		end

		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			lastGood, lastGround = nil, nil
			return
		end

		local wantBlock = S.AfNoRagdoll
		if lastHum ~= hum or lastBlock ~= wantBlock then
			if lastHum and lastHum ~= hum and lastBlock then applyStates(lastHum, false) end
			applyStates(hum, wantBlock)
			lastHum, lastBlock = hum, wantBlock
		end
		if wantBlock then
			local st = hum:GetState()
			if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
			end
		end

		local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil
		local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horiz = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		local up = math.max(vel.Y, 0)

		local limit = S.AfSpeed
		if S.Fly then limit = math.max(limit, S.FlyMaxSps * 2.5) end
		if S.Bhop then limit = math.max(limit, S.BhopMax * 3) end
		if S.SpeedOn then limit = math.max(limit, S.Speed * 3) end
		if S.JumpOn then limit = math.max(limit, S.JumpPower * 3) end

		local angBad = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > S.AfAng and not S.Spin
		local bad = S.AfClamp and not seated and (math.max(horiz, up) > limit or angBad)

		if bad then
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			if lastGood then root.CFrame = lastGood end
			defNote("fling", S.AfNotify, "Антифлінг: удар погашено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
		elseif not seated then
			lastGood = root.CFrame
			if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
				lastGround = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			end
		else
			lastGood = nil
		end

		if S.AfVoid and lastGround then
			local floorY = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 80
			if root.Position.Y < floorY then
				markSelf(0.5)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				char:PivotTo(lastGround)
				defNote("void", S.AfNotify, "Антифлінг: повернено з прірви", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
			end
		end

		scanT += dt
		if scanT >= 0.1 then
			scanT = 0
			local now = os.clock()
			for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if plr ~= player then
					local r = getRoot(plr.Character)
					if r then
						local ang = r.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
						local lin = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
						if ang > S.AfAng * 1.5 or lin > S.AfSpeed * 2 then
							if (flagged[plr] or 0) < now then
								defNote("fl_" .. plr.UserId, S.AfNotify, "Підозра на fling: %s",
									Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 80), 4, plr.DisplayName)
							end
							flagged[plr] = now + 6
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) flagged[plr] = nil end)
end)

safeRun("defense", function()
	local defFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	defFolder.Name = "FunModeDefense"
	defFolder.Parent = playerGui

	local localFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	localFolder.Name = "FunModeLocal"
	localFolder.Parent = workspace

	local function topLabel(y, color)
		local l = makeText(UI.gui, UDim2.fromOffset(380, 24), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, y, 0), "", 16, color, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
		l.Visible = false
		return l
	end
	local awLabel = topLabel(0.21, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80))
	local tpLabel = topLabel(0.26, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))

	local track = {}
	local jumpHooks = {}
	local function onEnemyJump(fn) jumpHooks[#jumpHooks + 1] = fn end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not gateOpen or not (S.Counter or S.TpHl) then
			if next(track) ~= nil then table.clear(track) end
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local base = math.max(15, dt * 250)

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player then
				local char = plr.Character
				local root = getRoot(char)
				local rec = track[plr]

				if not (root and isAlive(char)) then
					track[plr] = nil
				elseif not rec or rec.root ~= root then
					track[plr] = { root = root, pos = root.Position, born = now }
				else
					local pos = root.Position
					local from = rec.pos
					local jump = (pos - from).Magnitude
					rec.pos = pos
					if jump >= base and now - rec.born > 1 then
						for _, fn in jumpHooks do fn(plr, char, from, pos, jump) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local enemyCd, lastCounter = {}, 0
	local faceChar, faceUntil = nil, 0

	local function trigger(plr, char)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastCounter < S.CtCooldown then return end
		if now - (enemyCd[plr] or 0) < S.CtCooldown * 2 then return end
		lastCounter, enemyCd[plr] = now, now

		local name = plr.DisplayName
		if S.CtMode == 3 then
			toast(string.format(tr("До вас тепнувся: %s"), name), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 80), true)
			return
		end

		task.delay(S.CtDelay, function()
			if not (gateOpen and S.Counter) then return end
			if not (isAlive(char) and isAlive(player.Character)) then return end

			if S.CtMode == 1 then
				if teleportNear(char, 1) then
					toast(string.format(tr("Контр-ТП: %s"), name), ACCENT, true)
				end
			else
				toast(string.format(tr("Розворот на: %s"), name), ACCENT, true)
			end
			if S.CtFace then
				faceChar, faceUntil = char, os.clock() + 0.35
			end
		end)
	end

	onEnemyJump(function(plr, char, from, pos, jump)
		if not (S.Counter and gateOpen) or jump < S.CtMinJump or isTeammate(plr) then return end
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		if not (myRoot and isAlive(myChar)) then return end

		local myPos = myRoot.Position
		if (pos - myPos).Magnitude > S.CtRadius or (from - myPos).Magnitude <= S.CtRadius then return end

		if S.CtBehindOnly then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local look = cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector or myRoot.CFrame.LookVector
			local lookFlat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			local flat = Vector3.new(pos.X - myPos.X, 0, pos.Z - myPos.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and lookFlat.Magnitude > 0.1 and lookFlat.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit) >= -0.2 then
				return
			end
		end
		trigger(plr, char)
	end)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeCounter", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function()
		if faceChar and os.clock() < faceUntil then
			local cam = getCamera()
			local part = faceChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(faceChar)
			if cam and part then
				cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position), 0.55)
			end
		elseif faceChar then
			faceChar = nil
		end
	end)

	onEnemyJump(function(plr, char, from, pos, jump)

	local function updateMarkers()
		local now = os.clock()
		local cam = getCamera()
		local myRoot = getRoot(player.Character)

		for plr, m in markers do
			if not S.TpHl or not gateOpen or now - m.born > m.life or not m.char.Parent then
				clearMarker(plr)
			else
				local r = getRoot(m.char)
				local d = (myRoot and r) and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
				m.l2.Text = string.format(tr("%d ст"), math.floor(d))
			end
		end

		local shown = false
		if S.TpHl and gateOpen and tpLabelPlr and now < tpLabelUntil and cam and myRoot then
			local r = getRoot(tpLabelPlr.Character)
			if r then
				tpLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ТП: %s %s %d ст"), tpLabelPlr.DisplayName,
					arrowFor(cam, r.Position), math.floor((r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude))

	local awRec = {}
	local awParams = RaycastParams.new()
	awParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local awLast = 0

	local function scanAim()
		local now = os.clock()
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		if not (myRoot and isAlive(myChar)) then
			table.clear(awRec)
			return nil
		end

		local target = myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		local best, bestSince

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player and (S.AwTeam or not isTeammate(plr)) then
				local char = plr.Character
				local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local root = getRoot(char)
				if root and isAlive(char) then
					local part = head or root
					local origin = part.Position
					local look = part.CFrame.LookVector
					local to = target - origin
					local dist = to.Magnitude
					local hit = false

					if dist >= 3 and dist <= S.AwRange then
						local allowed = math.max(S.AwAngle, math.deg(math.atan(1.5 / dist)))
						local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(to / dist), -1, 1)))
						hit = ang <= allowed
						if hit and S.AwWall then
							awParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, myChar }
							hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, to, awParams) == nil
						end
					end

					local rec = awRec[plr]
					if hit then
						if not rec then
							rec = { since = now, last = now }
							awRec[plr] = rec
						end
						rec.last = now
						if now - rec.since >= S.AwTime and (not bestSince or rec.since < bestSince) then
							best, bestSince = { plr = plr, pos = origin, dist = dist }, rec.since
						end
					elseif rec and now - rec.last > 0.25 then
						awRec[plr] = nil
					end
				else
					awRec[plr] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function updateAimWarn()
		local best = (S.AimWarn and gateOpen) and scanAim() or nil
		local cam = getCamera()
		if best and cam then
			awLabel.Text = string.format(tr("ПРИЦІЛ НА ВАС: %s %s %d ст"), best.plr.DisplayName,
				arrowFor(cam, best.pos), math.floor(best.dist))
			awLabel.TextTransparency = 0.05 + 0.3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(os.clock() * 12))
			awLabel.Visible = true
			awLast = os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - awLast > 0.3 then
			awLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end

	local suspRec = {}

	local function lookOf(char)
		local h = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(char)
		return h, h and h.CFrame.LookVector
	end

	local function snappedOnTarget(plr, origin, prevLook, curLook)
		for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if other ~= plr then
				local oc = other.Character
				local part = oc and (oc:FindFirstChild("Head") or getRoot(oc))
				if part and isAlive(oc) then
					local to = part.Position - origin
					local d = to.Magnitude
					if d >= 5 and d <= 700 then
						local dir = to / d
						local err = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(curLook:Dot(dir), -1, 1)))
						if err <= 2.5 then
							local prevErr = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(prevLook:Dot(dir), -1, 1)))
							if prevErr >= 25 then return true end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function removeTag(rec)
		if rec.tag then
			rec.tag:Destroy()
			rec.tag = nil
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not (gateOpen and S.Susp) then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then continue end
			if plr ~= player then
				local char = plr.Character
				local head, look
				if char then head, look = lookOf(char) end
				if char and head and look and isAlive(char) then
					local rec = suspRec[plr]
					if not rec then
						rec = { score = 0, lastEvent = 0, decayT = now }
						suspRec[plr] = rec
					end
					if rec.look and rec.head == head then
						local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(rec.look:Dot(look), -1, 1)))
						if ang >= S.SuspSnap and now - rec.lastEvent > 0.5
							and snappedOnTarget(plr, head.Position, rec.look, look) then
							rec.score += 1
							rec.lastEvent, rec.decayT = now, now
							if rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold and not rec.notified then
								rec.notified = true
								defNote("susp_" .. plr.UserId, S.SuspNotify, "Підозра на аімбот: %s",
									Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), 15, plr.DisplayName)
							end
						end
					end
					rec.look, rec.head = look, head
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	refreshSuspInfo = function()
		if not suspInfoLabel then return end
		local list = {}
		for plr, rec in suspRec do
			if rec.score > 0 then
				list[#list + 1] = { name = plr.DisplayName, score = rec.score, flagged = rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold }
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)

		local lines = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#list, 5) do
			local e = list[i]
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s%s  ×%d", e.flagged and "! " or "   ", e.name, e.score)
		end
		suspInfoLabel.Text = tr("Підозрілі") .. ":\n" .. (#lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or tr("немає"))
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.clock()
			for plr, rec in suspRec do
				if plr.Parent ~= Players then
					removeTag(rec)
					suspRec[plr] = nil
				else
					if rec.score > 0 and now - rec.decayT >= 20 then
						rec.score -= 1
						rec.decayT = now
					end
					local flagged = rec.score >= S.SuspThreshold
					if not flagged then rec.notified = false end

					local head = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
					if flagged and S.Susp and S.SuspTags and gateOpen and head then
						if not rec.tag or not rec.tag.Parent or rec.tag.Adornee ~= head then
							removeTag(rec)
							local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							bb.Adornee = head
							bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
							bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 20)
							bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
							bb.Parent = defFolder
							local l = makeText(bb, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.new(), "AIM?", 14,
								Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), FONT_B, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
							l.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
							rec.tag = bb
						end
					else
						removeTag(rec)
					end
				end
			end
			refreshSuspInfo()
		end
	end)

	local VEHICLE_WORDS = {
		"vehicle", "car", "tank", "truck", "jeep", "heli", "boat", "bike", "apc", "buggy",
		"транспорт", "машин", "танк", "авто", "вертол", "човен",
	}

	local function isVehicleSeat(seat)
		if seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then return true end
		local m = seat
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if N.CollectionService:HasTag(m, "Vehicle") then return true end
			local n = string.lower(m.Name)
			for _, w in VEHICLE_WORDS do
				if string.find(n, w, 1, true) then return true end
			end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function seatOwnerPlayer(seat)
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		while model do
			local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if plr then return plr end
			local parent = model.Parent
			model = parent and parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or nil
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function forcedSeat(seat)
		if S.SitMode == 3 then return true end
		if S.SitMode == 2 then return not isVehicleSeat(seat) end

		local owner = seatOwnerPlayer(seat)
		if owner and owner ~= player then return true end
		if not isVehicleSeat(seat) and seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > S.SitSpeed then return true end
		return false
	end

	local groundCF, airSince = nil, nil
	local flickPrev, flickRoot = nil, nil
	local lastUnsit = 0

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not gateOpen then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)

		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			groundCF, airSince, flickPrev, flickRoot = nil, nil, nil, nil
			return
		end
		if flickRoot ~= root then
			flickRoot, flickPrev, groundCF, airSince = root, nil, nil, nil
		end

		local pos = root.Position
		local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local seat = hum.SeatPart

		if S.AntiSit and seat and now - lastUnsit > 0.4 and forcedSeat(seat) then
			lastUnsit = now
			hum.Sit = false
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			local weld = seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
			if weld then pcall(function() weld:Destroy() end) end
			defNote("sit", S.SitNotify, "Анти-сидіння: вас зняли з сидіння", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
			seat = nil
		end

		local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
		if grounded or seat then
			airSince = nil
			if grounded and not seat and vel.Y > -20 then groundCF = root.CFrame end
		else
			airSince = airSince or now
		end

		if S.AntiFall and groundCF and not seat and not S.Fly and now > selfMoveUntil then
			local h = pos.Y - groundCF.Position.Y
			local airTime = airSince and (now - airSince) or 0
			local ownLift = S.JumpOn or S.InfJump
			local tooHigh = (not ownLift) and airTime > 0.8 and h > S.FallHeight
			local tooFast = (not S.GravityOn) and vel.Y < -S.FallSpeed and h > 60
			if tooHigh or tooFast then
				markSelf(0.5)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				char:PivotTo(groundCF + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				airSince, flickPrev = nil, nil
				defNote("fall", S.FallNotify, "Анти-падіння: повернуто на землю", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
				return
			end
		end

		local reverted = false
		if S.AntiFlick and flickPrev and not seat and now - charBorn > 2 and now > selfMoveUntil then
			local d = (pos - flickPrev).Magnitude
			local limit = math.max(S.FlickDist, (vel.Magnitude + 100) * dt * 2)
			if d >= limit then
				local near = not S.FlickEnemyOnly
				if not near then
					for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
						if plr ~= player and not isTeammate(plr) then
							local r = getRoot(plr.Character)
							if r and ((r.Position - pos).Magnitude <= 40 or (r.Position - flickPrev).Magnitude <= 40) then
								near = true
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if near then
					if S.FlickRevert then
						markSelf(0.5)
						root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(flickPrev) * root.CFrame.Rotation)
						reverted = true
						defNote("flick", true, "Анти-ТП-флік: повернуто назад", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
					else
						defNote("flick", true, "Анти-ТП-флік: вас перемістили", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 2)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if not reverted then flickPrev = pos end
	end)

	local abSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local guiSaved, guiConns = {}, {}

	local function clampProp(inst, prop, limit, isMax)
		local cur = inst[prop]
		if (isMax and cur > limit) or ((not isMax) and cur < limit) then
			local s = abSaved[inst]
			if not s then
				s = {}
				abSaved[inst] = s
			end
			if s[prop] == nil then s[prop] = cur end
			inst[prop] = limit
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function clampEffects(container)
		local changed = false
		for _, inst in container:GetChildren() do
			if inst:IsA("BlurEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Size", S.AbBlur, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Brightness", S.AbBright, true) or changed
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Brightness", -0.8, false) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("BloomEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Intensity", S.AbBright * 4, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Intensity", 0.4, true) or changed
			elseif inst:IsA("Atmosphere") then
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Density", 0.6, true) or changed
				changed = clampProp(inst, "Haze", 6, true) or changed
			end
		end
		return changed
	end

	local function restoreEffects()
		for inst, props in abSaved do
			if inst.Parent then
				for prop, v in props do
					pcall(function() inst[prop] = v end)
				end
			end
			abSaved[inst] = nil
		end
	end

	local function restoreGui()
		for inst, s in guiSaved do
			if inst.Parent then pcall(function() inst[s.prop] = s.value end) end
			if guiConns[inst] then guiConns[inst]:Disconnect() end
			guiConns[inst] = nil
			guiSaved[inst] = nil
		end
	end

	local function guiIgnored(inst)
		local sg = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then return true end
		if string.sub(sg.Name, 1, 7) == "FunMode" then return true end
		local lname = string.lower(sg.Name)
		for token in string.gmatch(string.lower(S.AbIgnore), "[^,;]+") do
			token = string.gsub(token, "^%s+", "")
			token = string.gsub(token, "%s+$", "")
			if token ~= "" and string.find(lname, token, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function checkGui(inst)
		if not (S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen) then return end
		if not inst.Parent or guiSaved[inst] then return end
		if os.clock() - charBorn < 3 then return end

		local cam = getCamera()
		if not cam then return end
		local isFrame = inst:IsA("Frame")
		local isImg = inst:IsA("ImageLabel")
		if not (isFrame or isImg) then return end

		local vp, sz = cam.ViewportSize, inst.AbsoluteSize
		if sz.X < vp.X * 0.8 or sz.Y < vp.Y * 0.8 then return end
		if guiIgnored(inst) then return end

		local c, t, prop
		if isFrame then
			c, t, prop = inst.BackgroundColor3, inst.BackgroundTransparency, "BackgroundTransparency"
		else
			c, t, prop = inst.ImageColor3, inst.ImageTransparency, "ImageTransparency"
		end
		if (c.R + c.G + c.B) / 3 < 0.82 or t > 0.6 then return end

		guiSaved[inst] = { prop = prop, value = t }
		inst[prop] = 0.93
		guiConns[inst] = inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function()
			if S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen and inst[prop] < 0.93 then
				inst[prop] = 0.93
			end
		end)
		defNote("blind", S.AfNotify, "Анти-сліпота: ефект приглушено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 3)
	end

	playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		if S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and (inst:IsA("Frame") or inst:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
			task.delay(0.05, checkGui, inst)
		end
	end)

	local function blindTick()
		if S.AntiBlind and gateOpen then
			local c1 = clampEffects(Lighting)
			local cam = getCamera()
			local c2 = cam and clampEffects(cam) or false
			if c1 or c2 then
				defNote("blind", S.AfNotify, "Анти-сліпота: ефект приглушено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), 3)
			end
		elseif next(abSaved) ~= nil then
			restoreEffects()
		end
		if not (S.AntiBlind and S.AbGui and gateOpen) and next(guiSaved) ~= nil then
			restoreGui()
		end
	end

	local slowT = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		slowT += dt
		if slowT < 0.1 then return end
		slowT = 0
		updateMarkers()
		updateAimWarn()
		blindTick()
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
		track[plr], enemyCd[plr], awRec[plr] = nil, nil, nil
		clearMarker(plr)
		local rec = suspRec[plr]
		if rec then
			removeTag(rec)
			suspRec[plr] = nil
		end
	end)
end)
