		bb.MaxDistance = 1e5
		bb.Parent = pillar
		label = makeText(bb, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.new(), "SAFE", 14, SAFE_COLOR, FONT_B,
			Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, true)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	end

	local function findGround(root, char)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, folder }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), params)
		return hit and hit.Position or nil
	end

	local WARN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80)

	Safe.create = function()
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
			toast(tr("Немає живого персонажа"), WARN, true)
			return
		end
		local ground = findGround(root, char)
		if not ground then
			toast(tr("Не вдалося: під вами немає землі"), WARN, true)
			return
		end

		local lift
		if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			lift = root.Position.Y - ground.Y + 0.4
		elseif hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			lift = 3.4
		else
			lift = hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.4
		end

		Safe.cf = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) * root.CFrame.Rotation
		buildMarker(ground)
		applyVisuals()
		toast(tr("Безпечне місце створено"), SAFE_COLOR, true)
	end

	Safe.go = function()
		if not Safe.cf then
			toast(tr("Спершу створіть безпечне місце"), WARN, true)
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
		if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then return end
		if os.clock() - lastGo < 0.4 then return end
		lastGo = os.clock()

		if hum.SeatPart then hum.Sit = false end
		markSelf(0.9)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		char:PivotTo(Safe.cf)
		toast(tr("ТП у безпечне місце"), SAFE_COLOR, true)
	end

	Safe.delete = function()
		if not Safe.cf then return end
		Safe.cf = nil
		clearMarker()
		applyVisuals()
		toast(tr("Безпечне місце видалено"), N.C_DIM, true)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.2)
			local want = gateOpen and workspace or nil
			if folder.Parent ~= want then folder.Parent = want end
			if label and Safe.cf then
				local root = getRoot(player.Character)
				if root then
					label.Text = string.format(tr("SAFE · %d ст"), math.floor((root.Position - Safe.cf.Position).Magnitude))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("visuals", function()
	local overlay = UI.overlay
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "FunModeVisuals"
	folder.Parent = overlay

	local pool = {}
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function mkFrame(parent)
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.Visible = false
		f.Parent = parent
		return f
	end

	local function create()
		local e = {}
		e.box = mkFrame(folder)
		e.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		e.stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		e.stroke.Parent = e.box
		e.barBg = mkFrame(folder)
		e.barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
		e.barFill = mkFrame(e.barBg)
		e.barFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		e.barFill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		e.tracer = mkFrame(folder)
		e.tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		e.dot = mkFrame(folder)
		e.dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		corner(e.dot, 9999)
		e.arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		e.arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		e.arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
		e.arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		e.arrow.Text = ">"
		e.arrow.Font = FONT_B
		e.arrow.TextSize = 24
		e.arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		e.arrow.Visible = false
		e.arrow.Parent = folder
		return e
	end

	local function hide(e)
		e.box.Visible, e.barBg.Visible, e.tracer.Visible, e.dot.Visible, e.arrow.Visible = false, false, false, false, false
	end

	local function destroy(char)
		local e = pool[char]
		if e then
			for _, o in { e.box, e.barBg, e.tracer, e.dot, e.arrow } do o:Destroy() end
			pool[char] = nil
		end
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeVisuals", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 4, function()
		local cam = getCamera()
		local any = S.EspBox or S.EspTracer or S.EspHead or S.EspArrows
		if not (gateOpen and cam and any) then
			for char in pool do destroy(char) end
			return
		end

		local vp = cam.ViewportSize
		local center = vp / 2
		local myChar = player.Character
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { myChar } or {}
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local seen = {}

		local list = collect(false)
		if S.EspNPC and not S.IncludeNPCs then
			for _, c in npcList do
				if c.Parent then list[#list + 1] = { char = c } end
			end
		end
		for _, t in list do
			local char, plr = t.char, t.plr
			local hum, root = getHum(char), getRoot(char)
			if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 and (plr or S.EspNPC) and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not (S.EspHideTeam and isTeammate(plr)) then
				local dist = (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude
				if not (S.EspMaxDist < 5000 and dist > S.EspMaxDist) then
					seen[char] = true
					local e = pool[char]
					if not e then e = create() pool[char] = e end

					local color3 = nil
					if S.EspVisCheck then
						local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
						local h = workspace:Raycast(camPos, head.Position - camPos, rp)
						local visible = h == nil or h.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
						color3 = visible and Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
					end

					local headPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					local topPos = (headPart and headPart.Position or root.Position + up * 2) + up * ((headPart and headPart.Size.Y / 2 or 0.5) + 0.15)
					local feet = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 3 or (hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2)
					local botPos = root.Position - up * (feet + 0.1)
					local tsp, tOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(topPos)
					local bsp, bOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(botPos)
					local rootSp, rootOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
					local onScreen = tsp.Z > 0 and bsp.Z > 0 and rootSp.Z > 0 and (tOn or bOn or rootOn)
					local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = 0, 0, 0, 0
					if onScreen then
						local h = math.max(bsp.Y - tsp.Y, 4)
						local w = h * 0.55
						minX, maxX = rootSp.X - w / 2, rootSp.X + w / 2
						minY, maxY = tsp.Y, tsp.Y + h
					end
					local frac = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)

					if S.EspBox and onScreen then
						e.box.Visible = true
						e.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX, minY)
						e.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxX - minX, maxY - minY)
						e.stroke.Thickness = S.EspBoxThick
						e.stroke.Color = color3 or colorOf(S.EspBoxColor)
						if S.EspBar then
							local h = maxY - minY
							e.barBg.Visible = true
							e.barBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(minX - 6, minY)
							e.barBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
							e.barFill.Visible = true
							e.barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, frac)
							e.barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90), frac)
						else
							e.barBg.Visible = false
						end
					else
						e.box.Visible, e.barBg.Visible = false, false
					end

					if S.EspTracer and onScreen then
						local from
						if S.EspTracerFrom == 1 then from = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
						elseif S.EspTracerFrom == 2 then from = center
						else from = getAimPoint() end
						local to = Vector2.new((minX + maxX) / 2, maxY)
						local diff = to - from
						e.tracer.Visible = true
						e.tracer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diff.Magnitude, 1)
						e.tracer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((from.X + to.X) / 2, (from.Y + to.Y) / 2)
						e.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(diff.Y, diff.X))
						e.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = color3 or colorOf(S.EspTracerColor)
					else
						e.tracer.Visible = false
					end

					if S.EspHead and headPart then
						local hsp, hon = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(headPart.Position)
						if hon and hsp.Z > 0 then
							local r = math.clamp(300 / math.max(hsp.Z, 1), 3, 10)
							e.dot.Visible = true
							e.dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r * 2, r * 2)
							e.dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hsp.X, hsp.Y)
							e.dot.BackgroundColor3 = color3 or colorOf(S.EspHeadColor)
						else
							e.dot.Visible = false
						end
					else
						e.dot.Visible = false
					end

					if S.EspArrows and not onScreen then
						local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
						local dir = Vector2.new(rel.X, rel.Z)
						if dir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
							dir = dir.Unit
							local radius = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.38
							e.arrow.Visible = true
							e.arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X + dir.X * radius, center.Y + dir.Y * radius)
							e.arrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dir.Y, dir.X))
							e.arrow.TextColor3 = color3 or colorOf(S.EspArrowColor)
						else
							e.arrow.Visible = false
						end
					else
						e.arrow.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for char in pool do
			if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then destroy(char) end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("cheat-scanner", function()
	local FLAG_TEXT = { speed = "SPEED", fly = "FLY", noclip = "NOCLIP", spin = "SPIN", hitbox = "HITBOX", invis = "INVIS", lag = "LAG" }
	local FLAG_KEY = { speed = "DtSpeed", fly = "DtFly", noclip = "DtNoclip", spin = "DtSpin", hitbox = "DtHitbox", invis = "DtInvis", lag = "DtLag" }
	local FLAG_ORDER = { "speed", "fly", "noclip", "spin", "hitbox", "invis", "lag" }
	local RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "FunModeScan"
	folder.Parent = playerGui

	local recs = {}
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function newRec()
		return { fc = {}, dec = {}, notified = {}, speedT = 0, flyT = 0, spinT = 0, stillT = 0, nc = {}, invisT = 0, skipUntil = 0 }
	end

	local quietUntil, lastFrame, myLastPos = 0, os.clock(), nil
	local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

	local function hit(plr, rec, flag, now)
		if now < quietUntil then return end
		if now - (rec.lastHit and rec.lastHit[flag] or 0) < 1.2 then return end
		rec.lastHit = rec.lastHit or {}
		rec.lastHit[flag] = now
		rec.fc[flag] = (rec.fc[flag] or 0) + 1
		rec.dec[flag] = now
		if rec.fc[flag] >= S.DtThreshold and not rec.notified[flag] then
			rec.notified[flag] = true
			defNote("scan_" .. plr.UserId .. flag, S.DtNotify, "Підозра (%s): %s", RED, 10, FLAG_TEXT[flag], plr.DisplayName)
		end
	end

	local function flagged(rec, flag)
		return (rec.fc[flag] or 0) >= S.DtThreshold and S[FLAG_KEY[flag]]
	end

	local function removeGui(rec)
		if rec.tag then rec.tag:Destroy() rec.tag = nil end
		if rec.mark then rec.mark:Destroy() rec.mark = nil end
	end

	local function stateIs(hum, ...)
		local ok, st = pcall(function() return hum:GetState() end)
		if not ok then return false end
		for _, e in { ... } do
			if st == e then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local vrp = RaycastParams.new()
	vrp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	vrp.RespectCanCollide = true

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModeFreeze", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 5, function()
		if not (S.DtFreeze and gateOpen) then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		for plr, rec in recs do
			if rec.freezeUntil and rec.freezePivot then
				local char = plr.Character
				if now < rec.freezeUntil and char and char.Parent and rec.char == char then
					pcall(function()
						char:PivotTo(rec.freezePivot)
						char:SetAttribute("ZenithLocalMove", os.clock() + 2)
					end)
				else
					rec.freezeUntil, rec.freezePivot = nil, nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local lastStep = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not gateOpen or splashActive then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		local frameGap = now - lastFrame
		lastFrame = now
		if frameGap > 0.25 then quietUntil = now + 2 end
		local dt = now - lastStep
		if dt < 0.05 then return end
		lastStep = now
		local myChar = player.Character

		do
			local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
			if myRoot then
				if myLastPos and (myRoot.Position - myLastPos).Magnitude > 50 then quietUntil = now + 2 end
				myLastPos = myRoot.Position
			end
			local okP, ping = pcall(function() return StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
			if okP and ping and ping > 350 then quietUntil = math.max(quietUntil, now + 1) end
		end
		local quiet = now < quietUntil
		local camNow = getCamera()

		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if isPulled(plr.Character) then
				local r = recs[plr]
				if r then r.pos, r.skipUntil = nil, os.clock() + 1.5 end
				continue
			end
			if plr ~= player then
				local char = plr.Character
				local root, hum = getRoot(char), getHum(char)
				local rec = recs[plr]
				if not rec then rec = newRec() recs[plr] = rec end

				if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and char.Parent then
					local pos = root.Position
					local far = camNow and (camNow.CFrame.Position - pos).Magnitude > 350
					if quiet or far then rec.pos = nil end
					if rec.char ~= char then

						rec.char, rec.pos, rec.yaw = char, nil, nil
						rec.speedT, rec.flyT, rec.spinT, rec.stillT, rec.invisT = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
						rec.skipUntil = now + 3
					end

					if rec.pos then
						local pdt = now - rec.t
						local delta = pos - rec.pos
						local dist = delta.Magnitude

						if dist > 60 then rec.skipUntil = now + 1.5 end
						local skip = now < rec.skipUntil
						local seated = hum.SeatPart ~= nil or hum.Sit
						local airborne = hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air

						if not skip and pdt > 0 then

							local physical = stateIs(hum, Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
								Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
							if physical or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then rec.skipUntil = now + 1 end
							if S.DtSpeed and not seated and not airborne and not physical then
								local hs = Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude / pdt
								if hs > S.DtSpeedMax or (hs > 35 and hs > hum.WalkSpeed * 2.2) then
									rec.speedT += pdt
									if rec.speedT >= 0.6 then rec.speedT = 0 hit(plr, rec, "speed", now) end
								else
									rec.speedT = math.max(rec.speedT - pdt, 0)
								end
							end

							if S.DtFly and not seated and airborne and math.abs(delta.Y) / pdt < 3
								and not stateIs(hum, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,
									Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) then
								rec.flyT += pdt
								if rec.flyT >= S.DtFlyTime then rec.flyT = 0 hit(plr, rec, "fly", now) end
							else
								rec.flyT = 0
							end

							if S.DtNoclip and dist > 0.8 and dist < 40 then
								rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { char, myChar } or { char }
								local r = workspace:Raycast(rec.pos, delta, rp)
								if r and r.Instance.CanCollide and r.Instance.Transparency < 1
									and (r.Instance:IsA("Terrain") or r.Instance.Size.Magnitude > 6) then
									local list = rec.nc
									list[#list + 1] = now
									while #list > 0 and now - list[1] > 4 do table.remove(list, 1) end
									if #list >= 3 then rec.nc = {} hit(plr, rec, "noclip", now) end
								end
							end

							if S.DtLag then
								if dist < 0.05 then
									rec.stillT += pdt
								else
									if rec.stillT > 1 and dist > 12 and dist < 60 then hit(plr, rec, "lag", now) end
									rec.stillT = 0
								end
							end

							if S.DtSpin and rec.yaw then
								local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
								local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
								local d = math.abs((yaw - rec.yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi)
								if d / pdt > S.DtSpinRate and dist / pdt < 40 then
									rec.spinT += pdt
									if rec.spinT >= 0.8 then rec.spinT = 0 hit(plr, rec, "spin", now) end
								else
									rec.spinT = math.max(rec.spinT - pdt, 0)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					rec.pos, rec.t = pos, now
					do
						local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
						rec.yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
					end

					if S.DtFreeze then
						local cam = getCamera()
						local anyFlag = false
						for _, f in FLAG_ORDER do
							if flagged(rec, f) then anyFlag = true break end
						end
						if cam and anyFlag then
							local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
							local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
							local vis = false
							if on and sp.Z > 0 then
								vrp.FilterDescendantsInstances = myChar and { char, myChar } or { char }
								local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
								vis = workspace:Raycast(camPos, head.Position - camPos, vrp) == nil
							end
							if vis then rec.visPivot = char:GetPivot() end
							if rec.vis ~= nil and rec.vis ~= vis and now - (rec.lastFreeze or 0) > S.DtFreezeCool then
								local pv = vis and char:GetPivot() or rec.visPivot
								if pv then
									rec.freezePivot = pv
									rec.freezeUntil = now + S.DtFreezeTime
									rec.lastFreeze = now
								end
							end
							rec.vis = vis
						else
							rec.vis = nil
						end
					end

					if now - (rec.slowT or 0) > 0.5 then
						rec.slowT = now
						if S.DtHitbox then
							local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
							local big = math.max(root.Size.X, root.Size.Y, root.Size.Z) > S.DtHitboxSize
								or (head and math.max(head.Size.X, head.Size.Y, head.Size.Z) > S.DtHitboxSize * 0.8)
							rec.bigT = big and (rec.bigT or 0) + 1 or 0
							if big and rec.bigT >= 3 and now >= quietUntil then
								rec.fc.hitbox, rec.dec.hitbox = S.DtThreshold, now
								if not rec.notified.hitbox then
									rec.notified.hitbox = true
									defNote("scan_" .. plr.UserId .. "hitbox", S.DtNotify, "Підозра (%s): %s", RED, 10, "HITBOX", plr.DisplayName)
								end
							end
						end
						if S.DtInvis then
							local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
							local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
							if head and torso and head.Transparency >= 0.98 and torso.Transparency >= 0.98
								and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
								rec.invisT += 0.5
								if rec.invisT >= 2 then
									rec.fc.invis, rec.dec.invis = S.DtThreshold, now
									if not rec.notified.invis then
										rec.notified.invis = true
										defNote("scan_" .. plr.UserId .. "invis", S.DtNotify, "Підозра (%s): %s", RED, 10, "INVIS", plr.DisplayName)
									end
								end
							else
								rec.invisT = 0
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local function buildInfo()
		local list = {}
		for plr, rec in recs do
			local names = {}
			for _, f in FLAG_ORDER do
				if flagged(rec, f) then names[#names + 1] = FLAG_TEXT[f] end
			end
			if #names > 0 then list[#list + 1] = string.format("%s  %s", plr.DisplayName, table.concat(names, "·")) end
		end
		table.sort(list)
		local lines = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#list, 6) do lines[i] = list[i] end
		return tr("Сканер: підозрілі") .. ":\n" .. (#lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or tr("немає"))
	end
	refreshDtInfo = function()
		if dtInfoLabel then dtInfoLabel.Text = buildInfo() end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			local now = os.clock()
			for plr, rec in recs do
				if plr.Parent ~= Players then
					removeGui(rec)
					recs[plr] = nil
				else
					local names = {}
					for _, f in FLAG_ORDER do
						if (rec.fc[f] or 0) > 0 and now - (rec.dec[f] or 0) >= 15 then
							rec.fc[f] -= 1
							rec.dec[f] = now
						end
						if (rec.fc[f] or 0) < S.DtThreshold then rec.notified[f] = false end
						if flagged(rec, f) then names[#names + 1] = FLAG_TEXT[f] end
					end

					local char = plr.Character
					local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

safeRun("motion", function()
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ZenithMotion"

	local cand, entries = {}, {}
	local lastScan, lastTick = 0, 0

	local function charOf(p)
		local m = p.Parent
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return m end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function modelOf(p)
		local m = p.Parent
		while m and m ~= workspace do
			if m:IsA("Model") then return m end
			m = m.Parent
		end
		return p
	end

	local function clear(entry)
		for _, a in entry.adorn do pcall(function() a:Destroy() end) end
		if entry.label then pcall(function() entry.label:Destroy() end) end
	end

	local function clearAll()
		for g, entry in entries do clear(entry) end
		table.clear(entries)
		table.clear(motionTargets)
	end

	local function rescan()
		local list, n = {}, 0
		local myChar = player.Character
		local minSize = S.MotMinSize
		for _, d in workspace:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d.Anchored and not d:IsA("Terrain") and d.Size.Magnitude >= minSize then
				if not (myChar and d:IsDescendantOf(myChar)) and not d:IsDescendantOf(folder) then
					local ch = charOf(d)
					local plrChar = ch and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ch)
					if not (plrChar and S.MotSkipPlayers) then
						n += 1
						list[n] = d
						if n >= 2500 then break end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		cand = list
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastTick < 0.15 then return end
		lastTick = now

		local want = gateOpen and (S.MotEsp or S.MotAim)
		local cam = getCamera()
		if not (want and cam) then
			if next(entries) ~= nil or #motionTargets > 0 then clearAll() end
			return
		end
		if folder.Parent ~= cam then folder.Parent = cam end

		if now - lastScan > 2 then
			lastScan = now
			rescan()
		end

		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local active, order = {}, {}
		for _, p in cand do
			if p.Parent and not p.Anchored then
				local v = p.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
				if v >= S.MotMinSpeed then
					local d = (p.Position - camPos).Magnitude
					if d <= S.MotDist then
						local g = modelOf(p)
						local rec = active[g]
						if not rec then
							rec = { g = g, main = p, speed = v, dist = d, parts = {} }
							active[g] = rec
							order[#order + 1] = rec
						end
						rec.parts[#rec.parts + 1] = p
						if p.Size.Magnitude > rec.main.Size.Magnitude then rec.main = p end
						if v > rec.speed then rec.speed = v end
						if d < rec.dist then rec.dist = d end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(order, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
		for i = #order, S.MotMaxCount + 1, -1 do order[i] = nil end

		table.clear(motionTargets)
		for _, rec in order do
			motionTargets[#motionTargets + 1] = { part = rec.main, model = rec.g, speed = rec.speed }
		end

		local color = colorOf(S.MotColor)
		local used = {}
		if S.MotEsp then
			for _, rec in order do
				local entry = entries[rec.g]
				if not entry then
					entry = { adorn = {}, seen = now }
					entries[rec.g] = entry
				end
				entry.seen = now
				used[rec.g] = true

				table.sort(rec.parts, function(a, b) return a.Size.Magnitude > b.Size.Magnitude end)
				local keep = {}
				for i = 1, math.min(#rec.parts, 6) do
					local part = rec.parts[i]
					keep[part] = true
					local a = entry.adorn[part]
					if not a then
						a = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
						a.Adornee = part
						a.Size = part.Size + Vector3.new(0.12, 0.12, 0.12)
						a.AlwaysOnTop = true
						a.ZIndex = 5
						a.Parent = folder
						entry.adorn[part] = a
					end
					a.Color3 = color
					a.Transparency = S.MotFillTrans
				end
				for part, a in entry.adorn do
					if not keep[part] or not part.Parent then
						pcall(function() a:Destroy() end)
						entry.adorn[part] = nil
					end
				end

				if S.MotLabel then
					local lb = entry.label
					if not lb then
						lb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
						lb.AlwaysOnTop = true
						lb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 20)
						lb.LightInfluence = 0
						local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
						t.Name = "T"
						t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
						t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						t.Font = FONT_B
						t.TextSize = 12
						t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
						t.Parent = lb
						lb.Parent = folder
						entry.label = lb
					end
					lb.Adornee = rec.main
					lb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, rec.main.Size.Y / 2 + 1.5, 0)
					local t = lb:FindFirstChild("T")
					if t then
						t.TextColor3 = color
						local nm = rec.g.Name
						if #nm > 18 then nm = string.sub(nm, 1, 18) end
						t.Text = string.format("%s  %dст  %dст/с", nm, math.floor(rec.dist), math.floor(rec.speed))
					end
				elseif entry.label then
					entry.label:Destroy()
					entry.label = nil
				end
			end
		end

		for g, entry in entries do
			if not used[g] and now - entry.seen > 0.5 or not g.Parent then
				clear(entry)
				entries[g] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("orbit", function()
	local orb = nil
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.RespectCanCollide = true

	local function finish(silent)
		local o = orb
		if not o then return end
		orb = nil
		pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ZenithOrbitCam") end)
		local char = player.Character
		local root = getRoot(char)
		if S.OrbitReturn and char and root and o.startCF then
			markSelf(1.5)
			char:PivotTo(o.startCF)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		if not silent then toast(tr("Бліц завершено"), ACCENT, true) end
	end
	orbitStop = function() finish(true) end

	orbitStart = function()
		if not gateOpen then return end
		if orb then finish() return end
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		if not (isAlive(myChar) and myRoot) then return end
		local t = getTarget(true)
		local tRoot = t and getRoot(t.char)
		if not tRoot then
			toast(tr("Бліц: немає цілі в колі FOV"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
			return
		end
		local rel = myRoot.Position - tRoot.Position
		if rel.Magnitude > S.OrbitMaxStart then
			toast(tr("Бліц: ціль занадто далеко"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
			return
		end
		local dir = S.OrbitDir == 2 and -1 or 1
		orb = { char = t.char, startCF = myRoot.CFrame, t0 = os.clock(), flip = os.clock(), dir = dir, angle = math.atan2(rel.Z, rel.X) }
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("ZenithOrbitCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
			if not orb or not S.OrbitFace then return end
			local cam = getCamera()
			local part = getAimPart(orb.char)
			if cam and part then
				cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
			end
		end)
		toast(tr("Бліц: обертання навколо цілі"), ACCENT, true)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local o = orb
		if not o then return end
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = getRoot(myChar)
		local tRoot = getRoot(o.char)
		local now = os.clock()
		if not (gateOpen and isAlive(myChar) and myRoot and o.char.Parent and isAlive(o.char) and tRoot)
			or now - o.t0 >= S.OrbitTime then
			finish()
			return
		end
		if S.OrbitDir == 3 and now - o.flip > 1 then
			o.flip = now
			o.dir = -o.dir
		end
		o.angle += o.dir * math.rad(S.OrbitSpeed) * dt
		local center = tRoot.Position
		local desired = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(o.angle), 0, math.sin(o.angle)) * S.OrbitRadius + Vector3.new(0, S.OrbitHeight, 0)
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { myChar, o.char }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(center, desired - center, rp)
		if hit then desired = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 1.5 end
		local look = Vector3.new(center.X, desired.Y, center.Z)
		local cf = (look - desired).Magnitude > 0.1 and CFrame.lookAt(desired, look) or CFrame.new(desired)
		markSelf(0.5)
		myChar:PivotTo(cf)
		myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)
end)

safeRun("fps", function()
	local saved = {}
	local removed = {}
	local work, wi = {}, 1
	local undo, ui = {}, 1
	local active, curKey = false, nil
	local gSaved = nil
	local lastKeep = 0

	local function ours(inst)
		local n = inst.Name
		return string.sub(n, 1, 7) == "FunMode" or string.sub(n, 1, 6) == "Zenith"
	end

	local function inCharacter(inst)
		local cur = inst.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= workspace do
			if cur:IsA("Model") and cur:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	local function save(inst, props)
		local rec = saved[inst]
		if not rec then
			rec = {}
			saved[inst] = rec
		end
		for k, v in props do
			if rec[k] == nil then rec[k] = v end
		end
	end

	local function apply(inst)
		if not inst.Parent or ours(inst) then return end
		local lv = S.FpsLevel
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			if S.FpsKeepChars and inCharacter(inst) then return end
			local props = { CastShadow = inst.CastShadow }
			if lv >= 2 then
				props.Material = inst.Material
				props.Reflectance = inst.Reflectance
			end
			local mesh = lv >= 3 and inst:IsA("MeshPart")
			if mesh then
				props.RenderFidelity = inst.RenderFidelity
				props.TextureID = inst.TextureID
			end
			save(inst, props)
			inst.CastShadow = false
			if lv >= 2 then
				inst.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				inst.Reflectance = 0
			end
			if mesh then
				pcall(function()
					inst.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
					inst.TextureID = ""
				end)
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
			if lv >= 2 and not (S.FpsKeepChars and inCharacter(inst)) then
				save(inst, { Transparency = inst.Transparency })
				inst.Transparency = 1
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			if lv >= 3 and not (S.FpsKeepChars and inCharacter(inst)) then
				removed[#removed + 1] = { inst = inst, parent = inst.Parent }
				inst.Parent = nil
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Beam") or inst:IsA("Fire")
			or inst:IsA("Smoke") or inst:IsA("Sparkles") then
			save(inst, { Enabled = inst.Enabled })
			inst.Enabled = false
		elseif inst:IsA("PostEffect") and not inst:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
			save(inst, { Enabled = inst.Enabled })
			inst.Enabled = false
		elseif inst:IsA("Atmosphere") and lv >= 3 then
			save(inst, { Density = inst.Density, Haze = inst.Haze, Glare = inst.Glare })
			inst.Density = 0
			inst.Haze = 0
			inst.Glare = 0
		end
	end

	local function applyGlobals()
		local lv = S.FpsLevel
		gSaved = {
			GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
			EnvironmentDiffuseScale = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
			EnvironmentSpecularScale = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
		}
		N.fpsShadows = gSaved.GlobalShadows
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
		if lv >= 2 then
			Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
			Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
		end
		local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
		if terrain then
			gSaved.terrain = {}
			for _, prop in { "Decoration", "WaterWaveSize", "WaterWaveSpeed", "WaterReflectance" } do
				local ok, v = pcall(function() return terrain[prop] end)
				if ok then gSaved.terrain[prop] = v end
			end
			pcall(function()
				terrain.Decoration = false
				terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
				terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
				terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
			end)
			gSaved.terrainRef = terrain
		end
		if lv >= 3 then
			pcall(function()
				local r = settings().Rendering
				gSaved.quality = r.QualityLevel
				r.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
			end)
		end
	end

	local function restoreGlobals()
		local g = gSaved
		gSaved = nil
		N.fpsShadows = nil
		if not g then return end
		if S.FullBright then
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
		else
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = g.GlobalShadows
		end
		Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = g.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
		Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = g.EnvironmentSpecularScale
		if g.terrainRef and g.terrain then
			for prop, v in g.terrain do pcall(function() g.terrainRef[prop] = v end) end
		end
		if g.quality then
			pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = g.quality end)
		end
	end

	local function startWork()
		active = true
		applyGlobals()
		work = workspace:GetDescendants()
		for _, d in Lighting:GetDescendants() do work[#work + 1] = d end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			for _, d in cam:GetChildren() do work[#work + 1] = d end
		end
		wi = 1
	end

	local function startUndo()
		active = false
		restoreGlobals()
		undo, ui = {}, 1
		for inst, rec in saved do undo[#undo + 1] = { inst = inst, rec = rec } end
		saved = {}
		work, wi = {}, 1
		for _, r in removed do
			if r.inst and r.parent and r.parent.Parent then pcall(function() r.inst.Parent = r.parent end) end
		end
		removed = {}
	end

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		if active then work[#work + 1] = inst end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local want = gateOpen and S.FpsBoost
		local key = tostring(S.FpsLevel) .. (S.FpsKeepChars and "k" or "a")

		if active and (not want or key ~= curKey) then
			startUndo()
		end

		if ui <= #undo then
			local last = math.min(ui + 599, #undo)
			for i = ui, last do
				local u = undo[i]
				if u.inst.Parent then
					for prop, v in u.rec do pcall(function() u.inst[prop] = v end) end
				end
			end
			ui = last + 1
			if ui > #undo then undo = {} ui = 1 end
			return
		end

		if want and not active then
			curKey = key
			startWork()
			return
		end

		if active then
			local last = math.min(wi + 399, #work)
			for i = wi, last do
				local inst = work[i]
				if inst then pcall(apply, inst) end
				work[i] = false
			end
			wi = last + 1
			if wi > #work and #work > 0 then work, wi = {}, 1 end

			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastKeep > 0.5 then
				lastKeep = now
				if Lighting.GlobalShadows then Lighting.GlobalShadows = false end
			end
		end
	end)
end)

			local col = N.COLORS[S.SkyColor][2]
			return { clock = S.SkyTime, amb = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.25), 0.7), out = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.35), 0.6),
				atm = col, dec = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5), dens = S.SkyDensity, haze = 1.5, tint = col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.7),
				sat = 0.15, fog = col, fe = 60000, bri = 2, stars = 0 }
		end
		return PRESETS[idx]
	end

	local function apply(now, dt)
		local pr = currentPreset(now)
		if not pr then return end
		local clock = pr.clock
		if S.SkyCycle > 0 then
			skyClock = (skyClock + dt * S.SkyCycle * 0.4) % 24
			clock = (pr.clock + skyClock) % 24
		end
		Lighting.ClockTime = clock
		Lighting.Ambient = pr.amb
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = pr.out
		Lighting.Brightness = pr.bri
		Lighting.FogColor = pr.fog
		Lighting.FogStart = 0
		Lighting.FogEnd = pr.fe
		local atm = ownAtm or (atmSaved and atmSaved.inst)
		if atm and atm.Parent then
			atm.Color = pr.atm
			atm.Decay = pr.dec
			atm.Density = (S.SkyPreset == 9 or S.SkyPreset == 10) and S.SkyDensity or pr.dens
			atm.Haze = math.min(pr.haze, 4)
			atm.Offset = 0.25
			atm.Glare = 0.2
		end
		if tintFx then
			tintFx.TintColor = pr.tint
			tintFx.Saturation = pr.sat
		end
		for sky in skySaved do
			if sky.Parent then sky.StarCount = S.SkyStars and pr.stars or 0 end
		end
	end

	local acc = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - lastT
		lastT = now
		local on = S.SkyOn and gateOpen and not splashActive
		if on then
			if not lastOn then engage() skyClock = 0 end
			if lastPreset ~= S.SkyPreset then skyClock = 0 lastPreset = S.SkyPreset end
			acc += dt
			if acc >= 0.05 then
				apply(now, acc)
				acc = 0
			end
		elseif lastOn then
			disengage()
		end
		lastOn = on
	end)
end)

safeRun("pull", function()
	local pulled, untilT, fixedCF

	local function release()
		if pulled then pulledChars[pulled] = os.clock() + 1.5 end
		pulled = nil
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep("FunModePull", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 6, function()
		if not pulled then return end
		local cam, myRoot = getCamera(), getRoot(player.Character)
		if not (cam and myRoot and pulled.Parent and isAlive(pulled) and os.clock() < untilT and gateOpen) then
			release()
			return
		end
		pulledChars[pulled] = math.huge
		pcall(function() pulled:SetAttribute("ZenithLocalMove", os.clock() + 2) end)

		if fixedCF then pcall(function() pulled:PivotTo(fixedCF) end) end
	end)

	pullStop = function()
		if pulled then release() end
	end

	pullToggle = function()
		if pulled then
			release()
			toast(tr("Притяг вимкнено"), ACCENT, true)
			return
		end

		local oldTeam = S.IgnoreTeam
		if S.PullTeam then S.IgnoreTeam = false end
		local ok, t = pcall(getTarget, S.PullUseFov)
		S.IgnoreTeam = oldTeam
		if not (ok and t) then
			toast(tr("Немає цілі для притягу"), Color3.fromRGB(215, 80, 85), true)
			return
		end

		local cam, myRoot = getCamera(), getRoot(player.Character)
		local tRoot, tHum = getRoot(t.char), getHum(t.char)
		if not (cam and myRoot and tRoot and tHum) then return end
		local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then flat = myRoot.CFrame.LookVector end
		flat = flat.Unit
		local pos = myRoot.Position + flat * S.PullDist
		local feet = tHum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 3 or (tHum.HipHeight + tRoot.Size.Y / 2)
		local gp = RaycastParams.new()
		gp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		gp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, t.char }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), gp)
		local y = hit and (hit.Position.Y + feet) or pos.Y
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, y, pos.Z)
		fixedCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(myRoot.Position.X, pos.Y, myRoot.Position.Z))
		pulled, untilT = t.char, os.clock() + S.PullTime
		pulledChars[pulled] = math.huge
		toast(string.format(tr("Притяг: %s"), t.plr and t.plr.DisplayName or t.char.Name), ACCENT, true)
	end
end)

safeRun("recolor", function()
	local MATS = { nil, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.Material.Glass }
	local saved = {}
	local tracked = {}
	local lastRun = 0

	local function remember(inst, prop)
		local rec = saved[inst]
		if not rec then rec = {} saved[inst] = rec end
		if rec[prop] == nil then rec[prop] = inst[prop] end
	end

	local function setProp(inst, prop, value)
		local ok = pcall(function()
			remember(inst, prop)
			inst[prop] = value
		end)
		return ok
	end

	local function restoreAll(onlyChar)
		for inst, rec in saved do
			if not onlyChar or inst:IsDescendantOf(onlyChar) or not inst.Parent then
				for prop, v in rec do pcall(function() inst[prop] = v end) end
				saved[inst] = nil
			end
		end
		if onlyChar then tracked[onlyChar] = nil else tracked = {} end
	end

	local function scan(char)
		local info = tracked[char]
		if not info then info = { parts = {}, t = -10 } tracked[char] = info end
		if os.clock() - info.t < 0.6 then return info end
		info.t = os.clock()
		local parts = {}
		for _, d in char:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				if d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then parts[#parts + 1] = d end
				if d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.TextureID ~= "" then setProp(d, "TextureID", "") end
			elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then

				pcall(function()
					remember(d, "Parent")
					d.Parent = nil
				end)
			elseif d:IsA("Shirt") then setProp(d, "ShirtTemplate", "")
			elseif d:IsA("Pants") then setProp(d, "PantsTemplate", "")
			elseif d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then setProp(d, "Graphic", "")
			end
		end
		info.parts = parts
		return info
	end

	local function wanted(plr)
		if plr == player then return S.ChrWho == 4 end
		if S.ChrWho == 1 or S.ChrWho == 3 then return true end
		if S.ChrWho == 2 then return not isTeammate(plr) end
		return false
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not (S.Chr and gateOpen) or splashActive then
			if next(saved) ~= nil or next(tracked) ~= nil then restoreAll() end
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastRun < 1 / 30 then return end
		lastRun = now

		local c1, c2 = N.CHR_COLORS[S.ChrColor][2], N.CHR_COLORS[S.ChrColor2][2]
		local mat = MATS[S.ChrMat]
		local seen = {}
		for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local char = plr.Character
			if char and char.Parent and wanted(plr) then
				seen[char] = true
				local info = scan(char)
				local n = #info.parts
				for i, part in info.parts do
					if part.Parent then
						local col
						if S.ChrStyle == 1 then
							col = c1
						elseif S.ChrStyle == 2 then
							col = Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.15 * S.ChrSpeed + i / math.max(n, 1) * 0.5) % 1, 0.9, 1)
						else
							local k = (math.sin(now * 2 * S.ChrSpeed + i * 0.35) + 1) / 2
							col = c1:Lerp(c2, k)
						end
						setProp(part, "Color", col)
						if mat then setProp(part, "Material", mat) end
						local rec = saved[part]
						if S.ChrAlpha > 0 then
							local orig = rec and rec.Transparency or part.Transparency
							setProp(part, "Transparency", math.max(orig, S.ChrAlpha))
						elseif rec and rec.Transparency ~= nil then
							part.Transparency = rec.Transparency
							rec.Transparency = nil
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for char in tracked do
			if not seen[char] then restoreAll(char) end
		end
	end)
end)

safeRun("third-person", function()
	local saved = nil
	local lastDist, pendingUntil = nil, 0

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if S.Tpv and gateOpen then
			if not saved then
				saved = {
					mode = player.CameraMode,
					min = player.CameraMinZoomDistance,
					max = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,
				}
				lastDist = nil
			end
			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

			if lastDist ~= S.TpvDist then

				pendingUntil = os.clock() + 0.2
				player.CameraMinZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
				player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.TpvDist
			elseif os.clock() >= pendingUntil then

				else

					player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = S.TpvDist

		elseif saved then
			player.CameraMode = saved.mode
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = saved.min
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = saved.max
			saved = nil
			lastDist = nil
		end
	end)
end)

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

getgenv().EspActive = getgenv().EspActive or false
getgenv().CurrentBind = getgenv().CurrentBind or Enum.KeyCode.F
local activeHighlights = {}
local folderConnection = nil
local isBinding = false

-- Очистка старых GUI при перезапуске
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SakuraEspGui") then CoreGui.SakuraEspGui:Destroy() end

-- СОЗДАНИЕ САКУРА GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SakuraEspGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

-- Главный фрейм (Тема Сакуры)

frame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

})

gradient.Parent = frame

toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.33, 0)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0

toggleBtn.Parent = frame

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
btnCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

-- Кнопка Бинда
local bindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
bindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 24)
bindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.67, 0)
bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 45)
bindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
bindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 210)
bindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
bindBtn.TextSize = 11
bindBtn.Text = "Бинд: " .. getgenv().CurrentBind.Name
bindBtn.Parent = frame

local bindCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bindCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
bindCorner.Parent = bindBtn


-- УЛЬТРА ОПТИМИЗИРОВАННАЯ ЛОГИКА ESP
local function clearAllESP()
    for figure, hl in pairs(activeHighlights) do
        if hl then hl:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(activeHighlights)
end

local function highlightFigure(figure)
    if not getgenv().EspActive or not figure or activeHighlights[figure] then return end
    if figure.Name == "Figure" or figure:IsA("Model") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)     -- Насыщенный розовый (цветок сакуры)
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)   -- Белый контур для четкости
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.Adornee = figure
        hl.Parent = CoreGui
        activeHighlights[figure] = hl
    end
end

-- Моментальный трекинг без задержек и циклов
local function scan()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ChameleonOpponent")
    if not folder then return end

    if getgenv().EspActive then
        for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            highlightFigure(obj)
        end
        if not folderConnection then
            folderConnection = folder.ChildAdded:Connect(highlightFigure)
        end
    else
        clearAllESP()
        if folderConnection then
            folderConnection:Disconnect()
            folderConnection = nil
        end
    end
end

local function updateUI()
    if getgenv().EspActive then
        toggleBtn.Text = "ESP: ВКЛЮЧЕН"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(219, 112, 147) -- Розовый неон
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "ESP: ВЫКЛЮЧЕН"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 45, 55)    -- Тусклый вишневый
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 140, 150)
    end
end

local function toggleESP()
    getgenv().EspActive = not getgenv().EspActive
    scan()
    updateUI()
end

-- Слушаем появление папки, если раунд обновился (Оптимальный ивент вместо цикла)
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child.Name == "ChameleonOpponent" and getgenv().EspActive then
        task.wait(0.05) -- Микро-пауза для инициализации папки игрой
        scan()
    end
end)

-- Хэндлеры кнопок интерфейса
toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleESP)

bindBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if isBinding then return end
    isBinding = true
    bindBtn.Text = "Нажмите клавишу..."
    bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 65)
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if isBinding then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            getgenv().CurrentBind = input.KeyCode
            bindBtn.Text = "Бинд: " .. input.KeyCode.Name
            bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 35, 45)
            isBinding = false
        end
        return
    end
    if not gpe and input.KeyCode == getgenv().CurrentBind then
        toggleESP()
    end
end)

-- Инициализация при старте
scan()
updateUI()

-- Enable AIM in the panel; aim follows only during a bow draw. Insert toggles the menu.
-- Optional native bow automation and scoped silent direction; both start OFF.

    Aim = false,
    SilentAim = false,
    AutoBow = false,
    SmartCharge = true,

    TrajectoryInterval = 1 / 144,
    IdleTrajectoryInterval = 1 / 144,

    MaxCandidates = 3,

    RunMathTests = false,
}

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Settings persistence -------------------------------------------------------
-- Auto-saves the menu's toggles to the executor's data folder and reloads them
-- on the next run, so the script returns exactly how you left it. Silently a
-- no-op on executors without a filesystem (readfile/writefile/isfile).
local CONFIG_FILE = "kingfisher_tribes_config.json"
local PERSIST = {
    "ESP", "Aim", "SilentAim", "AutoBow", "SmartCharge", "JumpPrediction",
    "NoRecoil", "StrafePrediction", "Trajectory", "Names", "FOVRadius", "PreferHighArc", "TargetPart",
    "CircleStrafe", "CircleStrafeMode", "ShowHud", "NoSpread",
    "Fly", "Speed", "SuperJump",
}
local fsRead   = type(readfile)  == "function" and readfile  or nil
local fsWrite  = type(writefile) == "function" and writefile or nil
local fsIsFile = type(isfile)    == "function" and isfile    or nil

local function serializeConfig()
    local out = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(PERSIST) do out[key] = Config[key] end
    local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(out) end)
    return ok and encoded or nil
end

local function loadConfig()
    if not (fsRead and fsIsFile) then return end
    local ok, raw = pcall(function()
        if fsIsFile(CONFIG_FILE) then return fsRead(CONFIG_FILE) end
        return nil
    end)
    if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" then return end
    local decoded
    ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, key in ipairs(PERSIST) do
        local saved = decoded[key]
        if saved ~= nil and type(saved) == type(Config[key]) then Config[key] = saved end
    end
end

local lastSavedSnapshot
local function saveConfig()
    if not fsWrite then return end
    local encoded = serializeConfig()
    if encoded and encoded ~= lastSavedSnapshot then
        if pcall(fsWrite, CONFIG_FILE, encoded) then lastSavedSnapshot = encoded end
    end
end

loadConfig()
lastSavedSnapshot = serializeConfig()

local function loadModule(path, key)
    task.spawn(function()
        local cursor = path[1]
        for i = 2, #path do
            cursor = cursor and cursor:WaitForChild(path[i], 12)
            if not active or not cursor then return end
        end
        if not cursor:IsA("ModuleScript") then return end
        local ok, value = pcall(require, cursor)
        if not active then return end
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then
            warn("[Kingfisher] " .. key .. " unavailable; using fallback.")
            return
        end
        modules[key] = value
        if key == "Camera" then syncMenuMouse() end
        if key == "Controller" and type(value.OnViewEvent) == "function" then
            local subscribed, disconnect = pcall(value.OnViewEvent, function(name, data)
                if not active or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
                if name == "Draw" then
                    lastTool = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                    drawing = data.on == true
                    selected, selectionTime = nil, -math.huge
                    if drawing then
                        drawStart = os.clock()
                        drawDuration = tonumber(data.time) or 1
                    end
                elseif name == "Release" then
                    local ok, err = true, nil
                    if applyAim and type(data.charge) == "number" then
                        ok, err = pcall(applyAim, math.clamp(data.charge, 0, 1), true)
                    end
                    drawing, selected = false, nil
                    if not ok then warn("[Kingfisher] Release adjustment failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
                end
            end)
            if subscribed and type(disconnect) == "function" then
                nativeDraw = true
                table.insert(destructors, disconnect)
            end
        end
        if installBowAdapters then installBowAdapters() end
        if installRecoilControl then installRecoilControl() end
    end)
end

-- Kinds whose shots are a single projectile we can lead a target with.
-- Bomb is a lobbed AoE and the game skips aim-assist for it, so it is excluded.
local AIMABLE_KINDS = {
    Bow = true, Crossbow = true, Musket = true, Pistol = true, Blunderbuss = true,
    Knives = true, Javelin = true, Sling = true,
}
-- Charge/draw weapons scale launch speed with charge (DrawnShot); the rest fire
-- at a fixed speed on a single input.
local CHARGE_KINDS = {Bow = true, Javelin = true}
-- Firearms are hitscan server-side (the client projectile is only a tracer):
-- the server raycasts instantly, so these need NO lead and NO drop -- aim dead
-- at the target's current position. Bows/crossbow/throwables stay projectile.
local HITSCAN_KINDS = {Musket = true, Pistol = true, Blunderbuss = true}
local aimHitscan = false -- set by bowInfo() to the equipped weapon's hitscan flag
local function weaponModel(kind) return CHARGE_KINDS[kind] and "charge" or "instant" end

-- Returns tool, tuning, id, kind, model for any aimable projectile weapon, or nil.
local function bowInfo()
    local character = player.Character
    local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool ~= lastTool then
        drawing, heldFallback = false, false
        selected, selectionTime = nil, -math.huge
        lastTool = tool
    end
    if not tool then return nil end
    local id = tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
    local fallback = fallbackWeapons[id]
    local tuning = fallback
    local kind = fallback and fallback.kind
    local weapons = modules.Weapons
    if weapons and type(weapons.Get) == "function" then
        local ok, definition = pcall(weapons.Get, id)
        if ok and type(definition) == "table" and AIMABLE_KINDS[definition.kind] then
            tuning = definition.tuning or tuning
            kind = definition.kind
        end
    end
    if not tuning or not kind or not AIMABLE_KINDS[kind] then return nil end
    aimHitscan = HITSCAN_KINDS[kind] == true
    return tool, tuning, id, kind, weaponModel(kind)
end

local function chargeFor(tuning)
    if drawing or (not nativeDraw and heldFallback) then
        local duration = nativeDraw and drawDuration or (tuning.drawTime or 1)
        return math.clamp((os.clock() - drawStart) / math.max(0.001, duration), 0, 1), true
    end
    return 1, false -- Idle visualization is explicitly a full-draw preview.
end

-- Neutralizes the client-side recoil/shake the game applies after a shot while
-- Config.NoRecoil is on. These are purely local camera/view effects, so wrapping
-- them is safe and fully reversible on unload. Reinstalled idempotently as the
-- native Util module becomes available.
local recoilCleanup
installRecoilControl = function()
    if recoilCleanup or not active then return end
    local util = modules.Util
    if type(util) ~= "table" then return end
    local originals, wrappers = {}, {}
    for _, name in ipairs({"Recoil", "RecoilSlow", "Shake"}) do
        if type(util[name]) == "function" then originals[name] = util[name] end
    end
    if not next(originals) then return end
    for name, fn in pairs(originals) do
        local wrapped = function(...)
            if active and Config.NoRecoil then return end
            return fn(...)
        end
        wrappers[name] = wrapped
        util[name] = wrapped
    end
    recoilCleanup = function()
        for name, fn in pairs(originals) do
            if util[name] == wrappers[name] then util[name] = fn end
        end
    end
    table.insert(destructors, function() if recoilCleanup then recoilCleanup() end end)
end
installRecoilControl()

local function attribute(model, owner, key)
    local value = model and model:GetAttribute(key)
    if value == nil and owner then value = owner:GetAttribute(key) end
    return value
end

local function isEnemy(model, owner)
    if model == player.Character or owner == player or not model:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return false end
    if attribute(model, owner, "Alive") == false then return false end
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local myMatch = attribute(player.Character, player, "MatchId")
    local theirMatch = attribute(model, owner, "MatchId")
    local myTeam = attribute(player.Character, player, "Team")
    local theirTeam = attribute(model, owner, "Team")
    if type(myMatch) == "string" and myMatch ~= "" then
        return theirMatch == myMatch and theirTeam ~= nil and myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= myTeam
    end
    return Config.IncludeTrainingDummies and CollectionService:HasTag(model, "TrainingDummy")
end

local function refreshTargets()
    local visited, valid = {}, {}
    local function visit(model, owner)
        if not model or not model:IsA("Model") or visited[model] then return end
        visited[model] = true
        if not isEnemy(model, owner) then return end
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local part = model:FindFirstChild(Config.TargetPart) or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        valid[model] = true
        local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local adornee = head and head:IsA("BasePart") and head or root
        local record = records[model]
        if not record then
            local highlight = make("Highlight", {
                Adornee = model, DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
                FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(243, 87, 89), FillTransparency = 0.8,
                OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 146, 127), OutlineTransparency = 0.1,

                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 42), StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0),
